en.slide: [Lời cô] Vào bài: "Good afternoon, little interpreters! 小翻译们好！" · Chuyển ý: "Now, tell your friend in Chinese. 现在用中文告诉你的朋友。" · Khen: "Perfect! 完全正确！" · Nhắc: "Don't translate every word. 不用每个字都翻译。" · Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung của buổi (cô quyết định có giải nghĩa không): interpreter, rainbow / 祝贺 1) Đọc truyện 'The Rainbow Concert' và điền 1–2 từ (dạng Flyers Reading Part 5, 5 chỗ trống): Leo's drum is ___. (broken) / Xiaomei's ___ has got an old drum. (uncle) / Leo can ___ it. (borrow) / There is a ___ over the school. (rainbow) / Leo plays very ___. (well) 2) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp – Trung → Anh (4 câu): 我钢琴弹得很好。/ 她小提琴拉得很好听。/ 你喜欢京剧吗？/ 我有两张今晚演出的票。 3) Dự án 'Buổi hòa nhạc của lớp': mỗi nhóm làm 1 thiệp mời: Come to our concert! / Day: ___ / Time: ___ p.m. / ___ plays the ___ very well. 4) [Chuyển ngữ] (NL5) Con đọc bảng chương trình buổi hòa nhạc bằng tiếng Trung (1. 合奏 2. 打鼓：Leo 3. 拉小提琴：Anna 4. 京剧：Nhan), nói lại ý chính cho khách chỉ hiểu tiếng Anh: First, everyone plays together. Then Leo plays the drums and Anna plays the violin. Last, Nhan is in a Beijing Opera show. [Bản nâng cao] (cho con trội tiếng Anh, ~3 phút) Leo kể: "On the afternoon of the school concert, I found that my drum was broken. I was really worried, because I had a solo that evening. Xiaomei phoned her uncle, who had an old drum at home, and he lent it to me. Outside it was only fifteen degrees, but the hall was warm and comfortable. When the concert started, there was a beautiful rainbow over the school. Anna played the violin, Nhan acted in a funny costume and I played the drums. Afterwards I gave the drum back and thanked Xiaomei's uncle for his help." → con nói lại cho rối Xiaomei bằng tiếng Trung (tóm 3 ý chính, rồi giải thích vì sao Leo rất lo). Mẫu: Leo的鼓破了。Xiaomei给叔叔打电话，叔叔有一个旧鼓，Leo可以借。演出的时候，Anna拉小提琴，Nhan是演员，Leo打鼓打得非常好。为什么Leo很担心？因为晚上他要一个人打鼓，可是他的鼓破了。 (Leo de gǔ pò le. Xiaomei gěi shūshu dǎ diànhuà, shūshu yǒu yí gè jiù gǔ, Leo kěyǐ jiè. Yǎnchū de shíhou, Anna lā xiǎotíqín, Nhan shì yǎnyuán, Leo dǎ gǔ dǎ de fēicháng hǎo. Wèi shénme Leo hěn dānxīn? Yīnwèi wǎnshang tā yào yí gè rén dǎ gǔ, kěshì tā de gǔ pò le.)
en.truyen: The Rainbow Concert — Leo has got a problem. The school concert is tonight, but his drum is broken. 'I need a drum from somewhere!' he says. Xiaomei speaks to her uncle on the telephone. He has got an old drum and Leo can borrow it. Outside it's only fifteen degrees, but the hall is warm and comfortable. In the evening, there is a rainbow over the school. Anna plays a violin solo beautifully, Nhan is an actor in a funny costume and Leo plays the drums very well. After the concert, Leo says to Xiaomei's uncle, 'Thank you! I kept your drum safe.' 'You played very well!' says the uncle.
en.baihat: Our Concert (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus) — The drums at the concert go boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom, boom. / The drums at the concert go boom, boom, boom, all night long! / The violins at the concert play a beautiful tune... all night long! / The actors on the stage speak very well... all night long!

zh.flash: Ôn toàn unit: 除了 chúle, 借 jiè, 讨厌 tǎoyàn, 小提琴 xiǎotíqín, 演出 yǎnchū, 演员 yǎnyuán, 鼓 gǔ, 钢琴 gāngqín, 弹钢琴 tán gāngqín, 地 de, 推 tuī, 说 shuō, 聊天 liáotiān, 放好 fànghǎo, 几个 jǐ gè, 没有人 méiyǒu rén | Ôn: 问题 wèntí, 舒服 shūfu, 度 dù, 零 líng, 暖和 nuǎnhuo | Nghe làm quen: 邀请卡 yāoqǐngkǎ, 演出服 yǎnchūfú, 舞台 wǔtái
zh.slide: 1) Đọc truyện '彩虹演出' và phán đoán đúng/sai (dạng YCT4 đọc – phán đoán, 4 câu): Leo的鼓破了。(✓) / 叔叔有一个新鼓。(✗) / 学校上面有彩虹。(✓) / Leo打鼓打得不好。(✗) 2) Phiên dịch nhí – Anh → Trung (4 câu): I can play the piano well. / The actors performed very well. / How well does he sing? / I've got two tickets for tonight's show. 3) Dự án 'Buổi hòa nhạc của lớp': mỗi nhóm nói 3 câu: 我们的演出在星期___晚上___点。/ ___弹钢琴弹得很好。/ 一共有___个演员。 4) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng thiệp mời 'Buổi hòa nhạc của lớp': rối Leo đọc bản tiếng Anh (Come to our concert! Saturday, 7 p.m.), rối Xiaomei đọc bản tiếng Trung (来看我们的演出吧！星期六晚上七点。Lái kàn wǒmen de yǎnchū ba! Xīngqīliù wǎnshang qī diǎn.); con tìm thông tin giống nhau (ngày, giờ, con số) và khác (7 p.m. ↔ 晚上七点: buổi trước, giờ sau).
zh.truyen: 彩虹演出 — Leo有一个问题。今天晚上学校有演出，可是Leo的鼓破了。Leo说：“我要在别的地方找一个鼓！”Xiaomei给叔叔打电话。叔叔有一个旧鼓，Leo可以借。外面只有十五度，可是里面很暖和，很舒服。晚上，学校上面有彩虹。Anna一个人拉小提琴，拉得很好听；Nhan是演员，他的演出服很好笑；Leo打鼓打得非常好。演出以后，Leo对叔叔说：“谢谢叔叔！您的鼓我放得好好的。”叔叔说：“你打得真好！”(Leo yǒu yí gè wèntí. Jīntiān wǎnshang xuéxiào yǒu yǎnchū, kěshì Leo de gǔ pò le. Leo shuō: “Wǒ yào zài bié de dìfang zhǎo yí gè gǔ!” Xiaomei gěi shūshu dǎ diànhuà. Shūshu yǒu yí gè jiù gǔ, Leo kěyǐ jiè. Wàimiàn zhǐ yǒu shíwǔ dù, kěshì lǐmiàn hěn nuǎnhuo, hěn shūfu. Wǎnshang, xuéxiào shàngmiàn yǒu cǎihóng. Anna yí gè rén lā xiǎotíqín, lā de hěn hǎotīng; Nhan shì yǎnyuán, tā de yǎnchūfú hěn hǎoxiào; Leo dǎ gǔ dǎ de fēicháng hǎo. Yǎnchū yǐhòu, Leo duì shūshu shuō: “Xièxie shūshu! Nín de gǔ wǒ fàng de hǎohāo de.” Shūshu shuō: “Nǐ dǎ de zhēn hǎo!”)
zh.baihat: 我们的演出 (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus, như bài tiếng Anh) — 演出的鼓咚咚咚，咚咚咚，咚咚咚。演出的鼓咚咚咚，一整晚！演出的小提琴拉得真好听……一整晚！台上的演员说得真好……一整晚！(Yǎnchū de gǔ dōng dōng dōng, dōng dōng dōng, dōng dōng dōng. Yǎnchū de gǔ dōng dōng dōng, yì zhěng wǎn! Yǎnchū de xiǎotíqín lā de zhēn hǎotīng… yì zhěng wǎn! Tái shang de yǎnyuán shuō de zhēn hǎo… yì zhěng wǎn!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 29. Unit 7 · Sports – Thể thao (1/4): đua xe, thể dục dụng cụ, Why – Because

web.label: Ngày 57. Unit 7 · Cuộc đua xe đạp

en.tu: Mới: score, race, cycle | Ôn nhanh: air, lift (ride) | Ôn: football (US soccer), goal, team, win, bike, tyre
en.cum: Mới: racing (car; bike) / a bike race / a car race / score a goal / cycle to school | Ôn: play football / win a match
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: hỏi lý do Why…? – Because…] Why do you like swimming? – Because swimming is good for my health. / Why do you like bike racing? – Because it's fast and fun. / What's the score? – It's two–one. / I cycle to school every morning. / Oh no! My bike has got a flat tyre. – Let's fix it before the race.
en.truyen: The Bike Race — On Sunday, there is a bike race in the park. 'Why do you like bike racing?' asks Anna. 'Because it's fast and fun!' says Leo. Leo cycles very fast. The air is cold, but he doesn't stop. He comes first! After the race, Dad gives Leo a lift home in the car.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "sports vocabulary for kids cycling racing score"

zh.tu: Mới: 比赛 bǐsài (= race, match) | Ôn nhanh: 空气 kōngqì, 送他回家 sòng tā huí jiā | Ôn: 踢足球 tī zúqiú, 进球 jìn qiú, 赢 yíng, 骑自行车 qí zìxíngchē | Nghe làm quen: 轮胎 lúntāi (= tyre)
zh.cum: Mới: 自行车比赛 zìxíngchē bǐsài / 足球比赛 zúqiú bǐsài | Ôn: 骑自行车上学 qí zìxíngchē shàngxué / 二比一 èr bǐ yī / 进一个球 jìn yí gè qiú
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] Why do you like swimming? – Because swimming is good for my health. ↔ 你为什么喜欢游泳？——因为游泳对身体很好。(Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan yóuyǒng? — Yīnwèi yóuyǒng duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.) · giống: Because ↔ 因为 đứng đầu câu trả lời · khác: Why đứng đầu câu ↔ 为什么 đứng sau 你; bike race ↔ 自行车比赛 (race ↔ 比赛) / [Ngữ pháp: 为什么……？——因为……] 你为什么喜欢游泳？(Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan yóuyǒng?) / 因为游泳对身体很好。(Yīnwèi yóuyǒng duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.) / 你为什么喜欢自行车比赛？——因为很快，很有意思。(Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan zìxíngchē bǐsài? — Yīnwèi hěn kuài, hěn yǒu yìsi.) / 几比几？——二比一。(Jǐ bǐ jǐ? — Èr bǐ yī.) / 我每天早上骑自行车上学。(Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang qí zìxíngchē shàngxué.) / 我的自行车轮胎没气了。——比赛以前我们修一修吧。(Wǒ de zìxíngchē lúntāi méi qì le. — Bǐsài yǐqián wǒmen xiū yi xiū ba.)
zh.truyen: 自行车比赛 — 星期天，公园里有自行车比赛。Anna问Leo：“你为什么喜欢自行车比赛？”Leo说：“因为很快，很有意思！”Leo骑得很快。天气很冷，可是他不停。他得了第一！比赛以后，爸爸开车送他回家。(Xīngqītiān, gōngyuán lǐ yǒu zìxíngchē bǐsài. Anna wèn Leo: “Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan zìxíngchē bǐsài?” Leo shuō: “Yīnwèi hěn kuài, hěn yǒu yìsi!” Leo qí de hěn kuài. Tiānqì hěn lěng, kěshì tā bù tíng. Tā déle dì-yī! Bǐsài yǐhòu, bàba kāichē sòng tā huí jiā.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "自行车比赛 儿童中文 为什么 因为"

web.label: Ngày 58. Unit 7 · Huấn luyện viên và thể dục dụng cụ

en.tu: Mới: coach, gymnastics, golf, chess, interested | Ôn nhanh: pyjamas (US pajamas), air | Ôn: badminton, tennis, basketball, hockey
en.cum: Mới: do gymnastics / play golf / play chess / a gymnastics coach / be interested in | Ôn: play badminton / play basketball
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: can – khả năng; Why…? – Because…] Can you play chess? – Yes, I can. / I can play badminton, but I can't play tennis. / Gymnastics can be dangerous. / Xiaomei is interested in gymnastics. / Why do you like chess, Grandpa? – Because it makes me think.
en.truyen: Xiaomei's Gymnastics — Xiaomei does gymnastics every Tuesday. Her coach is very friendly. The sports hall is clean and the air is cool. Today, Xiaomei's brother is doing a kung fu show. He can do kung fu very well! After that, Grandpa plays chess and golf with them. 'Why do you like chess, Grandpa?' 'Because it makes me think!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "gymnastics golf chess for kids English"

zh.tu: Mới: 体操 tǐcāo (= gymnastics), 体育馆 tǐyùguǎn (= sports hall), 打 dǎ (= play: badminton, tennis), 功夫 gōngfu (= kung fu), 表演 biǎoyǎn (= show), 感兴趣 gǎn xìngqù (= be interested in) | Nghe làm quen: 教练 jiàoliàn (= coach), 下棋 xiàqí (= play chess), 高尔夫球 gāo'ěrfūqiú (= golf) | Ôn nhanh: 干净 gānjìng, 空气 kōngqì, 睡衣 shuìyī | Ôn: 网球 wǎngqiú, 羽毛球 yǔmáoqiú, 篮球 lánqiú
zh.cum: Mới: 做体操 zuò tǐcāo / 去体育馆 qù tǐyùguǎn / 打羽毛球 dǎ yǔmáoqiú / 打网球 dǎ wǎngqiú / 学功夫 xué gōngfu / 功夫表演 gōngfu biǎoyǎn / 对体操感兴趣 duì tǐcāo gǎn xìngqù | Nghe làm quen: 下棋 xiàqí / 打高尔夫球 dǎ gāo'ěrfūqiú
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] I can play badminton, but I can't play tennis. ↔ 我会打羽毛球，但是不会打网球。(Wǒ huì dǎ yǔmáoqiú, dànshì bú huì dǎ wǎngqiú.) · giống: can / can't ↔ 会 / 不会, but ↔ 但是 · khác: play badminton / tennis ↔ 打 (đánh bằng vợt), play football ↔ 踢足球 (đá bằng chân) / [Ngữ pháp: 会 – kỹ năng học được] 哥哥会功夫，功夫很好。(Gēge huì gōngfu, gōngfu hěn hǎo.) / 我会打羽毛球，但是不会打网球。(Wǒ huì dǎ yǔmáoqiú, dànshì bú huì dǎ wǎngqiú.) / Xiaomei对体操很感兴趣。(Xiaomei duì tǐcāo hěn gǎn xìngqù.) / 今天下午有功夫表演。(Jīntiān xiàwǔ yǒu gōngfu biǎoyǎn.) / 我们在体育馆打羽毛球。(Wǒmen zài tǐyùguǎn dǎ yǔmáoqiú.) / 你会下棋吗？——会。(Nǐ huì xiàqí ma? — Huì.) / 爷爷，你为什么喜欢下棋？——因为下棋让我想很多。(Yéye, nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan xiàqí? — Yīnwèi xiàqí ràng wǒ xiǎng hěn duō.) / [Chuyển ngữ] Con nghe truyện tiếng Anh 'Xiaomei's Gymnastics', nói lại ý chính cho Xiaomei bằng 2 câu tiếng Trung (ghi âm): Xiaomei每个星期二做体操。她哥哥会功夫，表演得很好。(Xiaomei měi gè xīngqī'èr zuò tǐcāo. Tā gēge huì gōngfu, biǎoyǎn de hěn hǎo.)
zh.truyen: Xiaomei的体操 — Xiaomei每个星期二做体操。她的教练很友好。体育馆很干净，里面很凉快。今天，Xiaomei的哥哥有功夫表演。他功夫表演得很好！然后，爷爷和他们一起下棋、打高尔夫球。Xiaomei问：“爷爷，你为什么喜欢下棋？”爷爷说：“因为下棋让我想很多！”(Xiaomei měi gè xīngqī'èr zuò tǐcāo. Tā de jiàoliàn hěn yǒuhǎo. Tǐyùguǎn hěn gānjìng, lǐmiàn hěn liángkuai. Jīntiān, Xiaomei de gēge yǒu gōngfu biǎoyǎn. Tā gōngfu biǎoyǎn de hěn hǎo! Ránhòu, yéye hé tāmen yìqǐ xiàqí, dǎ gāo'ěrfūqiú. Xiaomei wèn: “Yéye, nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan xiàqí?” Yéye shuō: “Yīnwèi xiàqí ràng wǒ xiǎng hěn duō!”)

en.flash: Mới: score, race, cycle, racing (car; bike), coach, gymnastics, golf, chess, interested | Ôn: football (US soccer), badminton, tennis, basketball, hockey, air, lift (ride), pyjamas (US pajamas), tyre, without | Tranh truyện (cùng thẻ tiếng Trung): sports hall, kung fu, show
en.slide: [Lời cô] Vào bài: "Good afternoon! Let's talk about sports. 我们说说运动吧。" · Chuyển ý: "Ready, steady, go! 预备——开始！" · Khen: "Fantastic! 真厉害！" · Nhắc: "Stand in a line, please. 请排好队。" · Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung của buổi (cô quyết định có giải nghĩa không): score, gymnastics / 体育馆 1) Nghe và nối tên với môn thể thao (dạng Flyers Listening Part 1, 5 người): Leo – bike racing / Xiaomei – gymnastics / Grandpa – golf / Nhan – chess / Anna – badminton. 2) Ghép câu hỏi Why với câu trả lời Because (4 cặp): Why do you like swimming? – Because it's good for my health. / Why does Grandpa play golf? – Because it's quiet. / Why do you like chess? – Because it makes me think. / Why is Leo happy? – Because he won the race. 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp với can: Can you play chess? – Yes, I can. / No, I can't. / I can play badminton, but I can't play tennis. Phương án nhiễu trong tranh: fork / knife / shelf. 4) Flyers Nói phần 3 (mẫu) – kể truyện theo 5 tranh 'The Flat Tyre' (cô là giám khảo, kể tranh 1; con kể tranh 2–5): Tranh 1 (cô): It's Sunday. Leo is ready for the bike race in the park. / Tranh 2: Oh no! His bike has got a flat tyre. Leo is sad. / Tranh 3: He can't race without a good tyre, so his coach helps him. / Tranh 4: They fix the tyre quickly and Leo cycles very fast. / Tranh 5: Leo comes first! Dad gives him a lift home in the car.
en.truyen: Sports Week — It's Sports Week at Leo's school. On Monday, there is a bike race. Leo cycles very fast and wins! On Tuesday, there is a football match. 'What's the score?' asks Dad. 'Three–two to our team!' On Wednesday, Xiaomei does gymnastics with her coach in the sports hall. On Thursday, her brother does a kung fu show. On Friday, Nhan plays table tennis with the teacher – and Grandpa teaches golf and chess. 'Why do you like Sports Week?' asks Mum. 'Because we can try a different sport every day!' says Leo.
en.baihat: Why Do You Like It? (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — Why do you like it? Why do you like it? / Swimming? Swimming? / Because it's good for me, because it's good for me, / Every day! Every day!

zh.flash: Mới: 比赛 bǐsài, 体育馆 tǐyùguǎn, 打 dǎ, 体操 tǐcāo, 功夫 gōngfu, 表演 biǎoyǎn, 感兴趣 gǎn xìngqù | Ôn: 踢足球 tī zúqiú, 打篮球 dǎ lánqiú, 羽毛球 yǔmáoqiú, 网球 wǎngqiú, 骑自行车 qí zìxíngchē, 空气 kōngqì, 睡衣 shuìyī | Nghe làm quen: 教练 jiàoliàn, 下棋 xiàqí, 高尔夫球 gāo'ěrfūqiú, 曲棍球 qūgùnqiú, 轮胎 lúntāi
zh.slide: 1) Nghe và nối tên với môn thể thao (như bài 1 tiếng Anh, 5 người): Leo – 自行车比赛 / Xiaomei – 做体操 / 爷爷 – 打高尔夫球 / Nhan – 下棋 / Anna – 打羽毛球 (con nghe rồi nối; 高尔夫球, 下棋 chỉ nghe hiểu). 2) Ghép 为什么 với 因为 (3 cặp): 你为什么喜欢游泳？– 因为游泳对身体很好。/ 爷爷为什么喜欢下棋？– 因为下棋让他想很多。/ Leo为什么很高兴？– 因为他赢了比赛。 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp với 会 (như bài 3 tiếng Anh): 你会下棋吗？——会。/ 不会。/ 我会打羽毛球，但是不会打网球。(Nǐ huì xiàqí ma? — Huì. / Bú huì. / Wǒ huì dǎ yǔmáoqiú, dànshì bú huì dǎ wǎngqiú.) Tranh nhiễu: như bài tiếng Anh. 4) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng bảng 'Sports Week': Why do you like Sports Week? – Because we can try a different sport every day! ↔ 你为什么喜欢体育周？——因为每天都可以试一种新的运动！(Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan tǐyù zhōu? — Yīnwèi měi tiān dōu kěyǐ shì yì zhǒng xīn de yùndòng!); con nhận xét: Why ↔ 为什么 (đứng sau chủ ngữ), Because ↔ 因为; play football ↔ 踢足球, play tennis ↔ 打网球. 5) [Chuyển ngữ] Con đọc bảng 'Sports Week' tiếng Anh (Monday – bike race / Tuesday – football match / Wednesday – gymnastics / Thursday – kung fu show / Friday – table tennis), nói lại ý chính cho bạn chỉ hiểu tiếng Trung: 星期一有自行车比赛，星期二有足球比赛，星期三做体操，星期四有功夫表演。(Xīngqīyī yǒu zìxíngchē bǐsài, xīngqī'èr yǒu zúqiú bǐsài, xīngqīsān zuò tǐcāo, xīngqīsì yǒu gōngfu biǎoyǎn.) [Bản nâng cao] (cho con trội tiếng Anh, ~3 phút) Leo đọc thông báo: "Sports Week starts next Monday with a bike race in the park, so please bring your bike. On Tuesday there's a football match between two classes after lunch. On Wednesday, a gymnastics coach is coming to teach us in the sports hall. On Thursday, Xiaomei's brother is doing a kung fu show at break time. On Friday, you can choose table tennis, golf or chess with Grandpa. Why are we doing this? Because the school wants every student to try a different sport and stay healthy." → con nói lại cho rối Xiaomei bằng tiếng Trung (tóm 3 ý chính, rồi giải thích vì sao trường tổ chức tuần thể thao). Mẫu: 星期一有自行车比赛，星期二有足球比赛。星期三和教练在体育馆做体操，星期四有功夫表演。星期五可以打乒乓球、打高尔夫球，也可以下棋。为什么有体育周？因为学校想让同学们每天都试一种新的运动，对身体很好。 (Xīngqīyī yǒu zìxíngchē bǐsài, xīngqī'èr yǒu zúqiú bǐsài. Xīngqīsān hé jiàoliàn zài tǐyùguǎn zuò tǐcāo, xīngqīsì yǒu gōngfu biǎoyǎn. Xīngqīwǔ kěyǐ dǎ pīngpāngqiú, dǎ gāo'ěrfūqiú, yě kěyǐ xiàqí. Wèi shénme yǒu tǐyù zhōu? Yīnwèi xuéxiào xiǎng ràng tóngxuémen měi tiān dōu shì yì zhǒng xīn de yùndòng, duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.)
zh.truyen: 体育周 — 这个星期是学校的体育周。星期一有自行车比赛，Leo骑得很快，得了第一！星期二有足球比赛。爸爸问：“几比几？”“三比二，我们赢了！”星期三，Xiaomei和教练在体育馆做体操。星期四，她哥哥有功夫表演。星期五，Nhan和老师打乒乓球，爷爷教大家打高尔夫球和下棋。妈妈问：“你为什么喜欢体育周？”Leo说：“因为每天都可以试一种新的运动！”(Zhège xīngqī shì xuéxiào de tǐyù zhōu. Xīngqīyī yǒu zìxíngchē bǐsài, Leo qí de hěn kuài, déle dì-yī! Xīngqī'èr yǒu zúqiú bǐsài. Bàba wèn: “Jǐ bǐ jǐ?” “Sān bǐ èr, wǒmen yíng le!” Xīngqīsān, Xiaomei hé jiàoliàn zài tǐyùguǎn zuò tǐcāo. Xīngqīsì, tā gēge yǒu gōngfu biǎoyǎn. Xīngqīwǔ, Nhan hé lǎoshī dǎ pīngpāngqiú, yéye jiāo dàjiā dǎ gāo'ěrfūqiú hé xiàqí. Māma wèn: “Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan tǐyù zhōu?” Leo shuō: “Yīnwèi měi tiān dōu kěyǐ shì yì zhǒng xīn de yùndòng!”)
zh.baihat: 为什么喜欢 (giai điệu Two Tigers 两只老虎 – cùng giai điệu Frère Jacques của bài tiếng Anh) — 为什么呀？为什么呀？游泳呢？游泳呢？因为对身体好，因为对身体好，每天游！每天游！(Wèi shénme ya? Wèi shénme ya? Yóuyǒng ne? Yóuyǒng ne? Yīnwèi duì shēntǐ hǎo, yīnwèi duì shēntǐ hǎo, měi tiān yóu! Měi tiān yóu!)

en.tu: Mới: ski, sledge, snowball, snowboard, snowboarding | Ôn (từ nối Unit 6): concert, actor, costume, borrow, keep, instrument
en.cum: Mới: go skiing / ride a sledge / throw a snowball / go snowboarding | Ôn: borrow a sledge / keep warm
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: can (khả năng) và Why…? – Because…] Can you ski? – No, I can't, but I can ride a sledge. / Why do you like snowboarding? – Because it's exciting. / Can I borrow your snowboard? / You can't ski here. It's dangerous.
en.truyen: Snow Holiday — In winter, Anna's family goes to the mountains. There is a lot of snow. First, they climb a small mountain. Anna can ski and ride a horse, but Leo can't. Leo borrows a sledge and rides down the hill. 'Why do you like sledging?' asks Anna. 'Because it's fast!' Then Dad goes snowboarding. He falls into the snow! Everyone laughs and throws snowballs. Mum takes lots of photos.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "winter sports for kids ski sledge snowboard"

zh.tu: Mới: 爬山 páshān (= climb a mountain), 骑马 qímǎ (= ride a horse), 照相 zhàoxiàng (= take photos) | Nghe làm quen: 滑雪 huáxuě (= ski), 雪橇 xuěqiāo (= sledge), 滑雪板 huáxuěbǎn (= snowboard), 雪球 xuěqiú (= snowball) | Ôn (từ nối Unit 6): 演出 yǎnchū, 演员 yǎnyuán, 借 jiè, 放好 fànghǎo, 演出服 yǎnchūfú
zh.cum: Mới: 去爬山 qù páshān / 会骑马 huì qímǎ / 给我照相 gěi wǒ zhàoxiàng / 在山上照相 zài shān shang zhàoxiàng | Nghe làm quen: 去滑雪 qù huáxuě / 坐雪橇 zuò xuěqiāo / 扔雪球 rēng xuěqiú
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] Can you ride a horse? ↔ 你会骑马吗？(Nǐ huì qímǎ ma?) · giống: ride ↔ 骑 dùng cho cả ngựa và xe đạp (ride a horse ↔ 骑马, ride a bike ↔ 骑自行车) · khác: Can đứng đầu câu ↔ 会 đứng sau 你, thêm 吗 / [Ngữ pháp: 会 / 能 và 为什么……因为……] 你会滑雪吗？——不会，可是我会坐雪橇。(Nǐ huì huáxuě ma? — Bú huì, kěshì wǒ huì zuò xuěqiāo.) / 你会骑马吗？——会，我骑得很好。(Nǐ huì qímǎ ma? — Huì, wǒ qí de hěn hǎo.) / 你为什么喜欢玩滑雪板？——因为很刺激。(Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan wán huáxuěbǎn? — Yīnwèi hěn cìjī.) / 我可以借你的滑雪板吗？(Wǒ kěyǐ jiè nǐ de huáxuěbǎn ma?) / 这里不能滑雪。(Zhèlǐ bù néng huáxuě.)
zh.truyen: 山上的假期 — 冬天，Anna一家去山上。山上有很多雪。他们先去爬山。Anna会滑雪，也会骑马，可是Leo不会。Leo借了一个雪橇，从山上滑下来。Anna问：“你为什么喜欢坐雪橇？”Leo说：“因为很快！”然后爸爸去玩滑雪板，他摔倒在雪里了！大家都笑了，一起扔雪球。妈妈照了很多相。(Dōngtiān, Anna yì jiā qù shān shang. Shān shang yǒu hěn duō xuě. Tāmen xiān qù páshān. Anna huì huáxuě, yě huì qímǎ, kěshì Leo bú huì. Leo jièle yí gè xuěqiāo, cóng shān shang huá xiàlái. Anna wèn: “Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan zuò xuěqiāo?” Leo shuō: “Yīnwèi hěn kuài!” Ránhòu bàba qù wán huáxuěbǎn, tā shuāidǎo zài xuě lǐ le! Dàjiā dōu xiào le, yìqǐ rēng xuěqiú. Māma zhàole hěn duō xiàng.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "冬天 滑雪 雪橇 儿童中文"

web.label: Ngày 60. Unit 7 · Sở thích: sưu tầm, xếp hình, nhạc pop và rock

en.tu: Mới: puzzle, collect | Ôn (từ nối Unit 6): drum, violin, tune, hate, speak | Ôn nhanh: lift (ride)
en.cum: Mới: pop music / rock music / do a puzzle / collect stamps | Ôn: play the drums / a happy tune
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: Why…? – Because…] Why do you collect stamps? – Because they're beautiful. / I like pop music, but my brother likes rock music. / Can you do this puzzle? – Yes, I can. / He hates rock music because it's too loud. / I practise the drums every day. I never stop! / [Chuyển ngữ] (NL5) Con nghe truyện tiếng Trung 'Nhan的爱好', nói lại ý chính cho Leo bằng 2 câu tiếng Anh (ghi âm): Nhan has got lots of hobbies and he plays the drums in a band. He can carry a very heavy bag.
en.truyen: Nhan's Hobbies — Nhan has got lots of hobbies. He collects stamps and he can do a puzzle with a hundred pieces. He plays the drums in a rock band. His sister wears glasses and she likes pop music. 'Why do you like rock music?' she asks. 'Because it's loud and exciting!' Then Nhan carries a big heavy bag from the door. 'You're very strong!' says his sister.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "hobbies for kids collect stamps puzzle pop music rock music"

zh.tu: Mới: 眼镜 yǎnjìng (= glasses), 提 tí (= carry), 坚持 jiānchí (= keep doing, never stop) | Nghe làm quen: 收集邮票 shōují yóupiào (= collect stamps), 拼图 pīntú (= puzzle), 流行音乐 liúxíng yīnyuè (= pop music), 摇滚乐 yáogǔnyuè (= rock music) | Ôn (từ nối Unit 6): 鼓 gǔ, 小提琴 xiǎotíqín, 讨厌 tǎoyàn, 说 shuō | Ôn nhanh: 门口 ménkǒu
zh.cum: Mới: 戴眼镜 dài yǎnjìng / 提包 tí bāo / 坚持练习 jiānchí liànxí / 每天坚持 měi tiān jiānchí | Nghe làm quen: 收集邮票 shōují yóupiào / 拼拼图 pīn pīntú
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] His sister wears glasses. ↔ 他的姐姐戴眼镜。(Tā de jiějie dài yǎnjìng.) · giống: wear glasses ↔ 戴眼镜 · khác: tiếng Anh dùng wear cho mọi thứ ↔ tiếng Trung 戴 (kính, đồng hồ, mũ) nhưng 穿 (quần áo, giày); glasses (-es) ↔ 眼镜 không đổi / [Ngữ pháp: 为什么……？——因为……; 能 – khả năng] 你为什么收集邮票？——因为邮票很漂亮。(Nǐ wèi shénme shōují yóupiào? — Yīnwèi yóupiào hěn piàoliang.) / 我喜欢流行音乐，可是哥哥喜欢摇滚乐。(Wǒ xǐhuan liúxíng yīnyuè, kěshì gēge xǐhuan yáogǔnyuè.) / 你会拼这个拼图吗？——会。(Nǐ huì pīn zhège pīntú ma? — Huì.) / 这个包很重，你能提吗？(Zhège bāo hěn zhòng, nǐ néng tí ma?) / 我每天坚持练习打鼓。(Wǒ měi tiān jiānchí liànxí dǎ gǔ.)
zh.truyen: Nhan的爱好 — Nhan有很多爱好。他收集邮票，还会拼一百块的拼图。他在摇滚乐队里打鼓。他的姐姐戴眼镜，喜欢流行音乐。姐姐问：“你为什么喜欢摇滚乐？”Nhan说：“因为摇滚乐很响，很有意思！”然后，Nhan从门口提进来一个又大又重的包。姐姐说：“你的力气真大！”(Nhan yǒu hěn duō àihào. Tā shōují yóupiào, hái huì pīn yì bǎi kuài de pīntú. Tā zài yáogǔn yuèduì lǐ dǎ gǔ. Tā de jiějie dài yǎnjìng, xǐhuan liúxíng yīnyuè. Jiějie wèn: “Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan yáogǔnyuè?” Nhan shuō: “Yīnwèi yáogǔnyuè hěn xiǎng, hěn yǒu yìsi!” Ránhòu, Nhan cóng ménkǒu tí jìnlái yí gè yòu dà yòu zhòng de bāo. Jiějie shuō: “Nǐ de lìqi zhēn dà!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "爱好 儿童中文 集邮 拼图"

en.flash: Mới: ski, sledge, snowball, snowboard, snowboarding, puzzle, collect, pop music, rock music | Ôn: concert, actor, costume, borrow, keep, instrument, drum, violin, tune, hate, lift (ride), climb a mountain, ride a horse, take photos, glasses, carry, never stop
en.slide: [Lời cô] Vào bài: "Brr, it's cold today! 今天真冷！" · Chuyển ý: "Now, it's Chinese time. 现在是中文时间。" · Khen: "Good thinking! 想得很好！" · Nhắc: "Hands up before you speak. 说话以前请举手。" · Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung của buổi (cô quyết định có giải nghĩa không): sledge, snowboard / 坚持 1) Đọc định nghĩa, viết từ (dạng Flyers Reading Part 1, 5 câu): You stand on this and go down the snow. (snowboard) / You sit on this and go down a hill in the snow. (sledge) / You make it with snow and throw it. (snowball) / You put the pieces together to make a picture. (puzzle) / Some people do this with stamps or shells. (collect) 2) Đọc và chọn đáp án (dạng Flyers Reading Part 3, 4 câu): Nhan likes ___ music because it's loud. (rock / pop) / His sister likes ___ music because it's happy. (pop / rock) / You can't ski here. It's ___. (dangerous / delicious) / Can I ___ your snowboard? (borrow / collect) 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp: Why do you like snowboarding? – Because it's exciting. / What do you collect? – I collect stamps. 4) Flyers Nói phần 4 (mẫu) – câu hỏi về bản thân, chủ đề sở thích (cô là giám khảo, từng em): Now let's talk about your hobbies. What do you collect? – I collect stamps. / Why do you like it? – Because it's interesting. / Which music do you like, pop or rock? – I like pop music. / What do you do in winter? – I play in the snow. / Tell me about your favourite sport. 5) [Chuyển ngữ] (NL5) Rối Xiaomei kể truyện tiếng Trung '山上的假期'; con tóm tắt cho rối Leo bằng 2–3 câu tiếng Anh: Anna's family goes to the mountains in December. Anna can ride a horse, but Leo can't. In the evening, they listen to music. [Bản nâng cao] (cho con trội tiếng Anh, ~3 phút) Leo kể: "In December, our family went on holiday in the mountains. There was thick snow everywhere, and it was much colder than at home. My sister Anna can ski and ride a horse, but I can't do either, so I borrowed a sledge instead. Dad tried snowboarding for the first time and fell into the snow, so we all laughed and threw snowballs. In the evenings we did a huge puzzle and listened to pop music. I wanted rock music, but Mum said it was too loud before bed." → con nói lại cho rối Xiaomei bằng tiếng Trung (tóm 3 ý chính, rồi giải thích vì sao mẹ không cho nghe nhạc rock). Mẫu: 十二月，Leo一家去山上过假期，山上到处都是雪。Anna会滑雪，也会骑马，可是Leo不会，所以他借了一个雪橇。晚上，他们一起拼拼图，听流行音乐。为什么不听摇滚乐？因为摇滚乐很响，妈妈说睡觉以前不听摇滚乐。 (Shí'èryuè, Leo yì jiā qù shān shang guò jiàqī, shān shang dàochù dōu shì xuě. Anna huì huáxuě, yě huì qímǎ, kěshì Leo bú huì, suǒyǐ tā jièle yí gè xuěqiāo. Wǎnshang, tāmen yìqǐ pīn pīntú, tīng liúxíng yīnyuè. Wèi shénme bù tīng yáogǔnyuè? Yīnwèi yáogǔnyuè hěn xiǎng, māma shuō shuìjiào yǐqián bù tīng yáogǔnyuè.)
en.truyen: The Snow Holiday — In December, Anna's family goes on holiday in the mountains. There is snow everywhere. Anna can ski and ride a horse, but Leo can't. Leo borrows a sledge and rides down the hill. 'Why do you like sledging?' asks Anna. 'Because it's fast!' Dad goes snowboarding and falls into the snow. Everyone laughs and throws snowballs. In the evening, they do a big puzzle and listen to pop music. Leo wants rock music, but Mum says, 'No rock music before bed!'
en.baihat: Snowball Song (giai điệu Jingle Bells – dân gian, hết bản quyền) — Snowballs, snowballs, throwing in the snow! / Ski and sledge and snowboard, down the hill we go! / Snowballs, snowballs, it's a lot of fun! / Pop music, rock music, dancing in the sun!

zh.flash: Nghe làm quen: 滑雪 huáxuě, 雪橇 xuěqiāo, 雪球 xuěqiú, 滑雪板 huáxuěbǎn, 拼图 pīntú, 收集邮票 shōují yóupiào, 流行音乐 liúxíng yīnyuè, 摇滚乐 yáogǔnyuè | Mới: 爬山 páshān, 骑马 qímǎ, 照相 zhàoxiàng, 眼镜 yǎnjìng, 提 tí, 坚持 jiānchí | Ôn: 演出 yǎnchū, 演员 yǎnyuán, 借 jiè, 放好 fànghǎo, 讨厌 tǎoyàn, 鼓 gǔ, 小提琴 xiǎotíqín
zh.slide: 1) Nghe và chỉ tranh (như bài 1 tiếng Anh; chỉ nghe hiểu, không chấm): 滑雪板 / 雪橇 / 雪球 / 拼图 / 邮票. 2) Đọc và chọn từ (dạng YCT4 đọc – chọn từ, 5 câu): 姐姐___眼镜。(戴) / 这个包很重，你能___吗？(提) / 我每天___练习打鼓。(坚持) / 我们去山上___吧。(照相) / 你会___吗？——会，我骑得很好。(骑马) 3) Nghe định nghĩa, nói từ (như bài 1 tiếng Anh, 3 câu): 你站在上面，从雪山上滑下来。(滑雪板) / 你坐在上面，从山上滑下来。(雪橇) / 用雪做的，可以扔。(雪球) (Nǐ zhàn zài shàngmiàn, cóng xuěshān shang huá xiàlái. / Nǐ zuò zài shàngmiàn, cóng shān shang huá xiàlái. / Yòng xuě zuò de, kěyǐ rēng.) 4) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp: 你为什么喜欢玩滑雪板？——因为很刺激。/ 你收集什么？——我收集邮票。/ 你会骑马吗？——会 / 不会。/ 你喜欢流行音乐还是摇滚乐？(con chỉ tranh để trả lời) 5) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng tranh 'The Snow Holiday': Anna can ride a horse, but Leo can't. ↔ Anna会骑马，Leo不会。(Anna huì qímǎ, Leo bú huì.); con tìm: can / can't ↔ 会 / 不会, but ↔ dấu phẩy (tiếng Trung có thể bỏ 但是); ride a horse ↔ 骑马, ride a bike ↔ 骑自行车 (cùng một động từ ride ↔ 骑).
zh.truyen: 山上的假期 — 十二月，Anna一家去山上过假期。山上到处都是雪。Anna会滑雪，也会骑马，可是Leo不会。Leo借了一个雪橇，从山上滑下来。Anna问：“你为什么喜欢坐雪橇？”Leo说：“因为很快！”爸爸去玩滑雪板，摔倒在雪里了。大家都笑了，一起扔雪球。晚上，他们一起拼一个很大的拼图，听流行音乐。Leo想听摇滚乐，可是妈妈说：“睡觉以前不听摇滚乐！”(Shí'èryuè, Anna yì jiā qù shān shang guò jiàqī. Shān shang dàochù dōu shì xuě. Anna huì huáxuě, yě huì qímǎ, kěshì Leo bú huì. Leo jièle yí gè xuěqiāo, cóng shān shang huá xiàlái. Anna wèn: “Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan zuò xuěqiāo?” Leo shuō: “Yīnwèi hěn kuài!” Bàba qù wán huáxuěbǎn, shuāidǎo zài xuě lǐ le. Dàjiā dōu xiào le, yìqǐ rēng xuěqiú. Wǎnshang, tāmen yìqǐ pīn yí gè hěn dà de pīntú, tīng liúxíng yīnyuè. Leo xiǎng tīng yáogǔnyuè, kěshì māma shuō: “Shuìjiào yǐqián bù tīng yáogǔnyuè!”)
zh.baihat: 雪球歌 (giai điệu Jingle Bells, như bài tiếng Anh) — 雪球，雪球，雪里扔雪球！滑雪、雪橇、滑雪板，一起滑下山！雪球，雪球，真的很好玩！流行音乐、摇滚乐，大家一起跳！(Xuěqiú, xuěqiú, xuě lǐ rēng xuěqiú! Huáxuě, xuěqiāo, huáxuěbǎn, yìqǐ huá xià shān! Xuěqiú, xuěqiú, zhēn de hěn hǎowán! Liúxíng yīnyuè, yáogǔnyuè, dàjiā yìqǐ tiào!)

en.tu: Mới: tent, x-ray | Ôn nhanh: air, pyjamas (US pajamas) | Ôn: hospital, doctor, broken, camp, fall over, without
en.cum: Mới: sleep in a tent / have an x-ray | Ôn: go camping / fall over
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: can't – không được phép; Why…? – Because…] You can't swim here. It's dangerous. / Why is Leo at the hospital? – Because he needs an x-ray. / We can sleep in a tent tonight. / I go running every morning. / Don't go camping without a torch!
en.truyen: The Camping Trip — The family is camping near a river. They put up their tent. 'Can we swim in the river?' asks Leo. 'No, you can't swim here. It's dangerous,' says Dad. Leo plays football and falls over. His arm hurts. At the hospital, the doctor gives him an x-ray. 'Don't worry. It isn't broken,' says the doctor. In the evening, they watch a sports programme on Dad's phone in the tent.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "camping vocabulary for kids tent"

zh.tu: Mới: 节目 jiémù (= programme), 危险 wēixiǎn (= dangerous) | Nghe làm quen: 帐篷 zhàngpeng (= tent), X光片 X guāngpiàn (= x-ray) | Ôn nhanh: 空气 kōngqì, 睡衣 shuìyī | Ôn: 医院 yīyuàn, 医生 yīshēng, 露营 lùyíng
zh.cum: Mới: 很危险 hěn wēixiǎn / 体育节目 tǐyù jiémù / 电视节目 diànshì jiémù | Nghe làm quen: 睡在帐篷里 shuì zài zhàngpeng lǐ / 拍X光片 pāi X guāngpiàn | Ôn: 去露营 qù lùyíng
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] You can't swim here. It's dangerous. ↔ 这里不可以游泳，很危险。(Zhèlǐ bù kěyǐ yóuyǒng, hěn wēixiǎn.) · giống: hai ý: không được – vì nguy hiểm · khác: here cuối câu ↔ 这里 đầu câu; It's dangerous ↔ 很危险 (không cần 是) / [Ngữ pháp: 可以 / 不可以 – được phép] 这里不可以游泳，很危险。(Zhèlǐ bù kěyǐ yóuyǒng, hěn wēixiǎn.) / 你为什么在医院？——因为我要拍X光片。(Nǐ wèi shénme zài yīyuàn? — Yīnwèi wǒ yào pāi X guāngpiàn.) / 今天晚上我们可以睡在帐篷里。(Jīntiān wǎnshang wǒmen kěyǐ shuì zài zhàngpeng lǐ.) / 没有手电筒，不要去露营！(Méiyǒu shǒudiàntǒng, bú yào qù lùyíng!) / 我每天早上跑步。(Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang pǎobù.) / 爸爸喜欢看体育节目。(Bàba xǐhuan kàn tǐyù jiémù.)
zh.truyen: 去露营 — 一家人在河边露营。他们搭好帐篷。Leo问：“我们可以在河里游泳吗？”爸爸说：“这里不可以游泳，很危险。”Leo去踢足球，摔倒了，胳膊很疼。在医院，医生给他拍了X光片。医生说：“别担心，骨头没有断。”晚上，大家在帐篷里看手机上的体育节目。(Yì jiā rén zài hé biān lùyíng. Tāmen dāhǎo zhàngpeng. Leo wèn: “Wǒmen kěyǐ zài hé lǐ yóuyǒng ma?” Bàba shuō: “Zhèlǐ bù kěyǐ yóuyǒng, hěn wēixiǎn.” Leo qù tī zúqiú, shuāidǎo le, gēbo hěn téng. Zài yīyuàn, yīshēng gěi tā pāile X guāngpiàn. Yīshēng shuō: “Bié dānxīn, gǔtou méiyǒu duàn.” Wǎnshang, dàjiā zài zhàngpeng lǐ kàn shǒujī shang de tǐyù jiémù.)

zh.cau: [Cầu nối] Why do you love Sports Day? – Because there are no maths lessons! ↔ 你为什么喜欢运动会？——因为今天没有数学课！(Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan yùndònghuì? — Yīnwèi jīntiān méiyǒu shùxué kè!) · giống: maths ↔ 数学 (môn đã học ở Unit 4) · khác: there are no ↔ 没有; lessons (-s) ↔ 课 không đổi / [Ngữ pháp: 为什么……因为…… và 会 / 可以 – ôn] 你为什么喜欢运动会？——因为今天没有数学课！(Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan yùndònghuì? — Yīnwèi jīntiān méiyǒu shùxué kè!) / 你最喜欢什么课？——科学，因为很有意思。(Nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme kè? — Kēxué, yīnwèi hěn yǒu yìsi.) / 你会滑雪吗？——会。(Nǐ huì huáxuě ma? — Huì.) / 课间休息的时候，我们踢足球。(Kèjiān xiūxi de shíhou, wǒmen tī zúqiú.) / [YCT口试（中级）第一部分 听后重复 (mẫu): con nghe từng câu rồi nói lại 1 lần, ghi âm trên Trang luyện nói, ≤10 phút] 你为什么喜欢运动会？因为今天没有数学课。(Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan yùndònghuì? Yīnwèi jīntiān méiyǒu shùxué kè.) / 课间休息的时候，我们有自行车比赛。(Kèjiān xiūxi de shíhou, wǒmen yǒu zìxíngchē bǐsài.) / Leo在足球比赛里进了一个球。(Leo zài zúqiú bǐsài lǐ jìnle yí gè qiú.) / Anna做体操做得很好。(Anna zuò tǐcāo zuò de hěn hǎo.) / [Chuyển ngữ] Con nghe truyện tiếng Anh 'Sports Day', nói lại ý chính cho Xiaomei bằng 2 câu tiếng Trung (ghi âm): 今天是运动会，没有数学课。Leo踢进一个球，Anna做体操做得很好。(Jīntiān shì yùndònghuì, méiyǒu shùxué kè. Leo tī jìn yí gè qiú, Anna zuò tǐcāo zuò de hěn hǎo.)
zh.truyen: 运动会 — 今天学校有运动会，没有数学课，也没有科学课！课间休息的时候，同学们有自行车比赛。在足球比赛里，Leo进了一个球。Anna做体操，她的教练说：“做得很好！”Leo问：“你为什么喜欢运动会？”Anna说：“因为这是我一年里最喜欢的一天！”(Jīntiān xuéxiào yǒu yùndònghuì, méiyǒu shùxué kè, yě méiyǒu kēxué kè! Kèjiān xiūxi de shíhou, tóngxuémen yǒu zìxíngchē bǐsài. Zài zúqiú bǐsài lǐ, Leo jìnle yí gè qiú. Anna zuò tǐcāo, tā de jiàoliàn shuō: “Zuò de hěn hǎo!” Leo wèn: “Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan yùndònghuì?” Anna shuō: “Yīnwèi zhè shì wǒ yì nián lǐ zuì xǐhuan de yì tiān!”)

en.slide: [Lời cô] Vào bài: "Hello, campers! 大家好！" · Chuyển ý: "Let's check. 我们看一看。" · Khen: "Very good! 很好！" · Nhắc: "Be careful! 注意安全！" · Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung của buổi (cô quyết định có giải nghĩa không): x-ray, tent / 节目 1) Nghe và tô màu / viết (dạng Flyers Listening Part 5, 5 lệnh): Colour the tent green. / Write 'DANGER' next to the river. / Colour the boy's football black and white. / Draw a puzzle on the table. / Colour the x-ray picture blue. 2) Ôn không tranh – nghe câu, nói môn thể thao (5 câu): You need a bike for this. (cycling) / You need snow and a board. (snowboarding) / You play it on a board with black and white pieces. (chess) / You hit a small white ball into a hole. (golf) / You jump and turn on the floor. (gymnastics) 3) Đóng vai đi cắm trại: Can we swim here? – No, you can't. It's dangerous. / Can we sleep in the tent? – Yes, you can.
en.truyen: The Camping Trip — On Saturday, the family goes camping near a river. They put up their tent. 'Can we swim in the river?' asks Leo. 'No, you can't swim here. It's dangerous,' says Dad. So Leo plays football. He runs too fast and falls over. His arm hurts! At the hospital, the doctor gives him an x-ray. 'Don't worry. It isn't broken,' says the doctor. In the evening, they watch a sports programme on Dad's phone in the tent. 'I go running every morning,' says Leo, 'but tomorrow I'm staying in the tent!'
en.baihat: Camping Song (giai điệu Row Row Row Your Boat) — Camp, camp, camp tonight, sleep inside the tent! / Don't swim in the river, it's dangerous, my friend! / Run, run, run so fast, kick the football high! / Be careful and play safe under the big blue sky!

zh.flash: Mới: 节目 jiémù, 危险 wēixiǎn | Ôn: 比赛 bǐsài, 自行车比赛 zìxíngchē bǐsài, 教练 jiàoliàn, 体操 tǐcāo, 数学 shùxué, 科学 kēxué | Nghe làm quen: 课间休息 kèjiān xiūxi, 帐篷 zhàngpeng, X光片 X guāngpiàn, 高尔夫球 gāo'ěrfūqiú, 下棋 xiàqí, 滑雪 huáxuě, 雪橇 xuěqiāo, 雪球 xuěqiú, 滑雪板 huáxuěbǎn, 拼图 pīntú, 收集 shōují, 流行音乐 liúxíng yīnyuè, 摇滚乐 yáogǔnyuè
zh.slide: 1) Nghe và tô màu / viết (như bài 1 tiếng Anh, 5 lệnh): 把帐篷涂成绿色。/ 在河旁边写“危险”。/ 把男孩的足球涂成黑白色。/ 在桌子上画一个拼图。/ 把X光片涂成蓝色。 2) Đóng vai đi cắm trại (như bài 3 tiếng Anh): 我们可以在河里游泳吗？——不可以，很危险。/ 我们可以睡在帐篷里吗？——可以。(Wǒmen kěyǐ zài hé lǐ yóuyǒng ma? — Bù kěyǐ, hěn wēixiǎn. / Wǒmen kěyǐ shuì zài zhàngpeng lǐ ma? — Kěyǐ.) · Chọn 会 / 能 / 可以 (3 câu): 我___游泳。(会) / 可是这里不___游泳。(可以) / 他胳膊疼，今天不___踢足球。(能) 3) Ôn không tranh – cô nói, con đoán (5 câu, như bài 2 tiếng Anh): 要骑自行车的比赛。(自行车比赛) / 要有雪和滑雪板。(滑雪板 – con chỉ tranh) / 在黑白的棋盘上玩。(下棋 – con chỉ tranh) / 把一个小白球打进洞里。(高尔夫球 – con chỉ tranh) / 在地上跳、转。(体操) 4) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng biển báo khu cắm trại: rối Leo đọc biển tiếng Anh You can't swim here., rối Xiaomei đọc biển tiếng Trung 这里不可以游泳。(Zhèlǐ bù kěyǐ yóuyǒng.); con nối từng biển tiếng Anh với biển tiếng Trung (Danger! ↔ 危险！, Be careful! ↔ 注意安全！), tìm điểm giống (cùng ý cấm) và khác (here cuối câu ↔ 这里 đầu câu). 5) [Chuyển ngữ] Rối Leo kể truyện tiếng Anh 'The Camping Trip'; con tóm tắt cho rối Xiaomei bằng 2–3 câu tiếng Trung: 他们去河边露营。这里不可以游泳，很危险。Leo的胳膊疼，可是没关系。(Tāmen qù hé biān lùyíng. Zhèlǐ bù kěyǐ yóuyǒng, hěn wēixiǎn. Leo de gēbo téng, kěshì méi guānxi.) [Bản nâng cao] (cho con trội tiếng Anh, ~3 phút) Leo kể: "Last Saturday our family went camping next to a river. After we put up the tent, I wanted to swim, but Dad said no. He explained that the river was deep and the water was moving very fast, so swimming there was dangerous. So I played football instead, but I ran too fast and fell over. My arm hurt a lot, so we went to the hospital and the doctor took an x-ray. Luckily, it wasn't broken. In the evening we watched a sports programme on Dad's phone inside the tent." → con nói lại cho rối Xiaomei bằng tiếng Trung (tóm 3 ý chính, rồi giải thích vì sao không được bơi). Mẫu: 星期六，Leo一家去河边露营。Leo踢足球的时候摔倒了，胳膊很疼，医生给他拍了X光片，骨头没有断。晚上，大家在帐篷里看手机上的体育节目。为什么这里不可以游泳？因为河里的水流得很快，很危险。 (Xīngqīliù, Leo yì jiā qù hé biān lùyíng. Leo tī zúqiú de shíhou shuāidǎo le, gēbo hěn téng, yīshēng gěi tā pāile X guāngpiàn, gǔtou méiyǒu duàn. Wǎnshang, dàjiā zài zhàngpeng lǐ kàn shǒujī shang de tǐyù jiémù. Wèi shénme zhèlǐ bù kěyǐ yóuyǒng? Yīnwèi hé lǐ de shuǐ liú de hěn kuài, hěn wēixiǎn.)
zh.truyen: 去露营 — 星期六，一家人去河边露营。他们搭好帐篷。Leo问：“我们可以在河里游泳吗？”爸爸说：“这里不可以游泳，很危险。”所以Leo去踢足球。他跑得太快，摔倒了，胳膊很疼！在医院，医生给他拍了X光片。医生说：“别担心，骨头没有断。”晚上，大家在帐篷里看爸爸手机上的体育节目。Leo说：“我每天早上跑步，可是明天我要在帐篷里休息！”(Xīngqīliù, yì jiā rén qù hé biān lùyíng. Tāmen dāhǎo zhàngpeng. Leo wèn: “Wǒmen kěyǐ zài hé lǐ yóuyǒng ma?” Bàba shuō: “Zhèlǐ bù kěyǐ yóuyǒng, hěn wēixiǎn.” Suǒyǐ Leo qù tī zúqiú. Tā pǎo de tài kuài, shuāidǎo le, gēbo hěn téng! Zài yīyuàn, yīshēng gěi tā pāile X guāngpiàn. Yīshēng shuō: “Bié dānxīn, gǔtou méiyǒu duàn.” Wǎnshang, dàjiā zài zhàngpeng lǐ kàn bàba shǒujī shang de tǐyù jiémù. Leo shuō: “Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang pǎobù, kěshì míngtiān wǒ yào zài zhàngpeng lǐ xiūxi!”)
zh.baihat: 露营歌 (giai điệu Row Row Row Your Boat, như bài tiếng Anh) — 今晚去露营，睡在帐篷里！河里游泳很危险，朋友不要去！跑，跑，跑得快，足球踢得高！注意安全一起玩，天空蓝又蓝！(Jīnwǎn qù lùyíng, shuì zài zhàngpeng lǐ! Hé lǐ yóuyǒng hěn wēixiǎn, péngyou bú yào qù! Pǎo, pǎo, pǎo de kuài, zúqiú tī de gāo! Zhùyì ānquán yìqǐ wán, tiānkōng lán yòu lán!)

en.truyen: Where's the Ball? — It's the school football match. The score is one–one. Then the ball disappears! 'What happened?' asks the coach. Leo hears a sound behind a tree. He finds the ball there and fetches it quickly. 'No problem!' he says. Leo doesn't stop running and at the end he scores a goal. Two–one! Everyone is very happy.

zh.cau: [Cầu nối] The score is one–one. … Two–one! ↔ 一比一。……二比一！(Yī bǐ yī. … Èr bǐ yī!) · giống: tỉ số là con số, cùng thứ tự hai đội · khác: dấu gạch (one–one) ↔ 比 ở giữa; scores a goal ↔ 踢进一个球 / [Ngữ pháp: 会 / 可以 – chuyển ngữ Anh → Trung] [Chuyển ngữ] Can you play football? → 你会踢足球吗？(Nǐ huì tī zúqiú ma?) / Why do you like swimming? – Because swimming is good for my health. → 你为什么喜欢游泳？——因为游泳对身体很好。(Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan yóuyǒng? — Yīnwèi yóuyǒng duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.) / You can't swim here. It's dangerous. → 这里不可以游泳，很危险。(Zhèlǐ bù kěyǐ yóuyǒng, hěn wēixiǎn.)
zh.truyen: 球去哪儿了？ — 今天学校有足球比赛，一比一。突然，球不见了！教练问：“怎么了？”Leo听到树后面有一个声音。他在那儿找到了球，很快地拿了回来。他说：“没问题！”Leo坚持跑，最后踢进一个球。二比一！大家都很高兴。(Jīntiān xuéxiào yǒu zúqiú bǐsài, yì bǐ yī. Tūrán, qiú bú jiàn le! Jiàoliàn wèn: “Zěnme le?” Leo tīngdào shù hòumiàn yǒu yí gè shēngyīn. Tā zài nàr zhǎodàole qiú, hěn kuài de nále huílái. Tā shuō: “Méi wèntí!” Leo jiānchí pǎo, zuìhòu tī jìn yí gè qiú. Èr bǐ yī! Dàjiā dōu hěn gāoxìng.)

zh.cum: Ôn: 喜欢功夫 xǐhuan gōngfu / 会骑马 huì qímǎ / 每天早上跑步 měi tiān zǎoshang pǎobù / 体育新闻 tǐyù xīnwén
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] Can you play football? – Yes, I can. ↔ 你会踢足球吗？——会。(Nǐ huì tī zúqiú ma? — Huì.) · giống: trả lời ngắn lặp lại can ↔ 会 · khác: Yes, I can ↔ chỉ nói 会 (không có từ yes); Korean / Japanese ↔ 韩国 / 日本 / [Ngữ pháp: 为什么……因为…… và 会 / 能 / 可以 – Phiên dịch nhí Trung → Anh] 你为什么喜欢游泳？——因为游泳对身体很好。(Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan yóuyǒng? — Yīnwèi yóuyǒng duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.) / 你会踢足球吗？(Nǐ huì tī zúqiú ma?) / 我每天早上跑步。(Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang pǎobù.) / 这里不可以游泳，很危险。(Zhèlǐ bù kěyǐ yóuyǒng, hěn wēixiǎn.)
zh.truyen: 小小体育记者 — Anna在学校网站上写体育新闻。她问一个韩国同学：“你为什么喜欢功夫？”他说：“因为功夫很有意思，对身体也很好。”她问一个日本同学：“你会骑马吗？”“会，我每个周末都骑马。”然后，Anna用英文和中文写新闻。(Anna zài xuéxiào wǎngzhàn shang xiě tǐyù xīnwén. Tā wèn yí gè Hánguó tóngxué: “Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan gōngfu?” Tā shuō: “Yīnwèi gōngfu hěn yǒu yìsi, duì shēntǐ yě hěn hǎo.” Tā wèn yí gè Rìběn tóngxué: “Nǐ huì qímǎ ma?” “Huì, wǒ měi gè zhōumò dōu qímǎ.” Ránhòu, Anna yòng Yīngwén hé Zhōngwén xiě xīnwén.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "儿童 体育记者 采访 中文"

en.flash: Ôn toàn unit: score, pop music, racing (car; bike), rock music, chess, collect, cycle, golf, puzzle, race, ski, sledge, snowball, snowboard, snowboarding, tent, x-ray, coach, gymnastics | Ôn: disappear, fetch, happen, sound, no problem, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, kung fu, ride a horse, dangerous, never stop
en.slide: [Lời cô] Vào bài: "Good afternoon, sports reporters! 体育小记者们好！" · Chuyển ý: "Now, tell me the main ideas. 现在说说主要的意思。" · Khen: "Great teamwork! 合作得很好！" · Nhắc: "Listen to your friend, please. 请听同学说。" · Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung của buổi (cô quyết định có giải nghĩa không): coach, reporter / 坚持 1) Đọc truyện 'Where's the Ball?' và trả lời (dạng Flyers Reading Part 4, 4 câu): What is the score at first? (one–one) / What disappears? (the ball) / Where does Leo find it? (behind a tree) / What's the score at the end? (two–one) 2) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp – Trung → Anh (4 câu): 你为什么喜欢游泳？/ 因为游泳对身体很好。/ 我会打羽毛球，但是不会打网球。/ 这里不可以游泳，很危险。 3) Dự án 'Phóng viên thể thao nhí': phỏng vấn 3 bạn: Why do you like ___? – Because ___. / Can you ___? – Yes, I can. / No, I can't. 4) [Chuyển ngữ] (NL5) Con đọc bài báo tiếng Trung '球去哪儿了？' của Anna, tóm tắt cho bạn chỉ hiểu tiếng Anh bằng 2–3 câu: The ball disappears, but Leo finds it behind a tree. He doesn't stop running and scores a goal. His team wins two–one. [Bản nâng cao] (cho con trội tiếng Anh, ~3 phút) Leo kể: "Yesterday we played a football match against another school, and the score was one–one for a long time. Suddenly the ball went over the fence and disappeared! Everyone stopped and looked for it, but nobody could find it. Then I heard a sound behind a big tree, so I went there and found the ball. I brought it back quickly so the match could start again. I didn't stop running, and in the last minute I scored a goal. We won two–one, and Anna wrote about it for the school website in English and Chinese." → con nói lại cho rối Xiaomei bằng tiếng Trung (tóm 3 ý chính, rồi giải thích Leo tìm thấy bóng bằng cách nào). Mẫu: 足球比赛开始是一比一，突然球不见了。Leo坚持跑，最后踢进一个球，二比一，他们赢了！Anna用英文和中文给学校网站写新闻。Leo怎么找到球的？他听到树后面有一个声音，就去那儿看，球就在那儿。 (Zúqiú bǐsài kāishǐ shì yī bǐ yī, tūrán qiú bú jiàn le. Leo jiānchí pǎo, zuìhòu tī jìn yí gè qiú, èr bǐ yī, tāmen yíng le! Anna yòng Yīngwén hé Zhōngwén gěi xuéxiào wǎngzhàn xiě xīnwén. Leo zěnme zhǎodào qiú de? Tā tīngdào shù hòumiàn yǒu yí gè shēngyīn, jiù qù nàr kàn, qiú jiù zài nàr.)
en.truyen: Where's the Ball? — It's the school football match. The score is one–one. Then the ball disappears! 'What happened?' asks the coach. Leo hears a sound behind a tree. He finds the ball there and fetches it quickly. 'No problem!' he says. Leo doesn't stop running and at the end he scores a goal. Two–one! After the match, Anna writes the news for the school website in English and Chinese: 'Why did our team win? Because Leo never stops!'
en.baihat: Sports Day Song (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus) — The bikes in the race go round and round, round and round, round and round. / The bikes in the race go round and round, all day long! / The coach in the hall says 'Run, run, run!'... all day long! / The ball in the net goes score, score, score!... all day long!

zh.flash: Ôn toàn unit: 比赛 bǐsài, 自行车比赛 zìxíngchē bǐsài, 体操 tǐcāo, 教练 jiàoliàn, 下棋 xiàqí, 高尔夫球 gāo'ěrfūqiú, 滑雪 huáxuě, 雪橇 xuěqiāo, 雪球 xuěqiú, 滑雪板 huáxuěbǎn, 拼图 pīntú, 收集 shōují, 流行音乐 liúxíng yīnyuè, 摇滚乐 yáogǔnyuè, 帐篷 zhàngpeng, X光片 X guāngpiàn, 功夫 gōngfu, 骑马 qímǎ, 危险 wēixiǎn, 坚持 jiānchí | Ôn: 不见了 bú jiàn le, 拿回来 ná huílái, 怎么了 zěnme le, 声音 shēngyīn, 没问题 méi wèntí, 中文 Zhōngwén, 日本 Rìběn, 韩国 Hánguó
zh.slide: 1) Đọc truyện '球去哪儿了？' và phán đoán đúng/sai (dạng YCT4 đọc – phán đoán, 4 câu): 比赛开始是一比一。(✓) / 球在桌子下面。(✗) / Leo听到一个声音。(✓) / 最后是三比一。(✗) 2) Phiên dịch nhí – Anh → Trung (4 câu): Why do you like swimming? / Can you play football? / I go running every morning. / Gymnastics can be dangerous. 3) Dự án 'Phóng viên thể thao nhí': 你为什么喜欢___？——因为___。/ 你会___吗？——会 / 不会。 4) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng bài báo thể thao song ngữ của Anna: The score is two–one. ↔ 二比一。/ Leo doesn't stop running. ↔ Leo坚持跑。(Èr bǐ yī. / Leo jiānchí pǎo.); con chỉ ra tỉ số giống nhau ở hai tiếng, khác: two–one ↔ 二比一 (thêm 比), doesn't stop ↔ 坚持.
zh.truyen: 球去哪儿了？ — 今天学校有足球比赛，一比一。突然，球不见了！教练问：“怎么了？”Leo听到树后面有一个声音。他在那儿找到了球，很快地拿了回来，说：“没问题！”Leo坚持跑，最后踢进一个球，二比一！比赛以后，Anna用英文和中文给学校网站写新闻：“我们为什么赢了？因为Leo一直坚持！”(Jīntiān xuéxiào yǒu zúqiú bǐsài, yì bǐ yī. Tūrán, qiú bú jiàn le! Jiàoliàn wèn: “Zěnme le?” Leo tīngdào shù hòumiàn yǒu yí gè shēngyīn. Tā zài nàr zhǎodàole qiú, hěn kuài de nále huílái, shuō: “Méi wèntí!” Leo jiānchí pǎo, zuìhòu tī jìn yí gè qiú, èr bǐ yī! Bǐsài yǐhòu, Anna yòng Yīngwén hé Zhōngwén gěi xuéxiào wǎngzhàn xiě xīnwén: “Wǒmen wèi shénme yíng le? Yīnwèi Leo yìzhí jiānchí!”)
zh.baihat: 运动会之歌 (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus, như bài tiếng Anh) — 比赛的自行车转啊转，转啊转，转啊转。比赛的自行车转啊转，转一整天！体育馆的教练说“跑跑跑”……一整天！球门里的球进进进……一整天！(Bǐsài de zìxíngchē zhuàn a zhuàn, zhuàn a zhuàn, zhuàn a zhuàn. Bǐsài de zìxíngchē zhuàn a zhuàn, zhuàn yì zhěng tiān! Tǐyùguǎn de jiàoliàn shuō “pǎo pǎo pǎo”… yì zhěng tiān! Qiúmén lǐ de qiú jìn jìn jìn… yì zhěng tiān!)

rows.label_buoi: Buổi dạy 33. Unit 8 · Illness – Ốm đau và sức khỏe (1/4): hỏi thăm, khuyên bảo should / 应该

web.label: Ngày 65. Unit 8 · Con bị làm sao thế?

en.tu: Mới: medicine, flu, rest, blood, injure | Ôn nhanh: online, you're welcome | Ôn: doctor, hospital, healthy, check-up, knee
en.cum: Mới: take some medicine / have got flu / have a rest / injure your knee | Ôn: see a doctor / feel tired
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: hỏi thăm What's the matter? và khuyên should] What's the matter with you? – I've got a headache. / I've got a cough and a fever. / You should take some medicine. / You should see a doctor. / He injured his knee. There's some blood on it.
en.truyen: Leo Is Ill — Leo doesn't want to get up. 'What's the matter with you?' asks Mum. 'I've got a headache and a cough. My head hurts a lot!' says Leo. Mum takes him to the doctor. 'You've got flu,' says the doctor. 'You should take this medicine and have a rest. You don't need an injection.' 'Thank you, doctor!' 'You're welcome.'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "What's the matter illness vocabulary for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 头疼 tóuténg (= headache), 咳嗽 késou (= cough), 应该 yīnggāi (= should), 打针 dǎzhēn (= have an injection), 受伤 shòushāng (= get hurt, injure), 受不了 shòu bu liǎo (= hurts too much, tranh) | Nghe làm quen: 流血 liú xiě (= blood), 膝盖 xīgài (= knee) | Ôn nhanh: 不客气 bú kèqi, 网上 wǎng shang | Ôn: 医生 yīshēng, 药 yào, 健康 jiànkāng, 体检 tǐjiǎn, 感冒 gǎnmào
zh.cum: Mới: 我头疼 wǒ tóuténg / 有点儿咳嗽 yǒudiǎnr késou / 应该吃药 yīnggāi chī yào / 去医院打针 qù yīyuàn dǎzhēn / 疼得受不了 téng de shòu bu liǎo / 膝盖受伤了 xīgài shòushāng le | Nghe làm quen: 流了一点儿血 liúle yìdiǎnr xiě
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] You should see a doctor. ↔ 你应该去看医生。(Nǐ yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.) · giống: should ↔ 应该 đứng trước động từ · khác: see a doctor ↔ 去看医生 (thêm 去); What's the matter? ↔ 你怎么了？ / [Ngữ pháp: 你怎么了？và 应该 + động từ] 你怎么了？(Nǐ zěnme le?) / 我头疼。(Wǒ tóuténg.) / 我咳嗽，还发烧。(Wǒ késou, hái fāshāo.) / 你应该吃药。(Nǐ yīnggāi chī yào.) / 你应该去看医生。(Nǐ yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.) / 我头疼得受不了！(Wǒ tóu téng de shòu bu liǎo!) / 他的膝盖受伤了，流了一点儿血。(Tā de xīgài shòushāng le, liúle yìdiǎnr xiě.)
zh.truyen: Leo生病了 — 早上，Leo不想起床。妈妈问：“你怎么了？”Leo说：“我头疼，还咳嗽。头疼得受不了！”妈妈带他去看医生。医生说：“你感冒了，应该吃药，多休息。不用打针。”Leo说：“谢谢医生！”医生说：“不客气。”(Zǎoshang, Leo bù xiǎng qǐchuáng. Māma wèn: “Nǐ zěnme le?” Leo shuō: “Wǒ tóuténg, hái késou. Tóu téng de shòu bu liǎo!” Māma dài tā qù kàn yīshēng. Yīshēng shuō: “Nǐ gǎnmào le, yīnggāi chī yào, duō xiūxi. Bú yòng dǎzhēn.” Leo shuō: “Xièxie yīshēng!” Yīshēng shuō: “Bú kèqi.”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "你怎么了 头疼 咳嗽 儿童中文"

web.label: Ngày 66. Unit 8 · Cẩn thận kẻo ngã!

en.tu: Mới: soap, shampoo, soft, lovely, ready | Ôn nhanh: pajamas (UK pyjamas), online | Ôn: wash, towel, ice cream
en.cum: Mới: wash your hands with soap / a bottle of shampoo / soft pyjamas / Are you ready? | Ôn: have a bath / be careful
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: should / shouldn't] You should wash your hands with soap. / You shouldn't eat ice cream. / These pyjamas are soft and lovely. / Are you ready for bed? – Yes, I am. / [Chuyển ngữ] (NL5) Con nghe truyện tiếng Trung '小心！', nói lại ý chính cho Leo bằng 2 câu tiếng Anh (ghi âm): Xiaomei's brother plays football and has a bath. Then he eats lots of ice cream and has a stomach-ache.
en.truyen: Be Careful! — Xiaomei's little brother is playing football in the garden. He is very hot. 'You should have a bath,' says Mum. 'Be careful! The floor is wet.' He washes with soap and shampoo. Then he puts on his soft, lovely pyjamas. After that, he eats lots of ice cream. At night, he has a stomach-ache and he runs to the toilet again and again. 'You shouldn't eat so much ice cream!' says Mum.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "should shouldn't health advice for kids"

zh.tu: Mới: 拉肚子 lā dùzi (= tranh: runs to the toilet again and again), 小心 xiǎoxīn (= be careful), 流汗 liú hàn (= tranh: very hot after football) | Nghe làm quen: 香皂 xiāngzào (= soap), 洗发水 xǐfàshuǐ (= shampoo), 软 ruǎn (= soft) | Ôn nhanh: 网上 wǎng shang | Ôn: 肚子疼 dùzi téng (stomach-ache), 洗 xǐ, 毛巾 máojīn, 冰淇淋 bīngqílín, 睡衣 shuìyī
zh.cum: Mới: 流了很多汗 liúle hěn duō hàn / 小心！xiǎoxīn! / 拉肚子了 lā dùzi le | Nghe làm quen: 用香皂洗手 yòng xiāngzào xǐ shǒu / 一瓶洗发水 yì píng xǐfàshuǐ / 软软的睡衣 ruǎnruǎn de shuìyī | Ôn: 肚子疼 dùzi téng
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] You shouldn't eat ice cream. ↔ 你不应该吃冰淇淋。(Nǐ bù yīnggāi chī bīngqílín.) · giống: shouldn't ↔ 不应该; ice cream ↔ 冰淇淋 (âm gần giống) · khác: Be careful! ↔ 小心！(không cần be) / [Ngữ pháp: 应该 / 不应该] 你不应该吃冰淇淋。(Nǐ bù yīnggāi chī bīngqílín.) / 你应该用香皂洗手。(Nǐ yīnggāi yòng xiāngzào xǐ shǒu.) / 这件睡衣又软又漂亮。(Zhè jiàn shuìyī yòu ruǎn yòu piàoliang.) / 准备好睡觉了吗？——好了！(Zhǔnbèi hǎo shuìjiào le ma? — Hǎo le!) / 小心！地上有水。(Xiǎoxīn! Dì shang yǒu shuǐ.) / 我流了很多汗，应该洗澡。(Wǒ liúle hěn duō hàn, yīnggāi xǐzǎo.)
zh.truyen: 小心！ — 弟弟在花园里踢足球，流了很多汗。妈妈说：“你应该洗澡。小心！地上有水！”他用香皂和洗发水洗澡，然后穿上又软又漂亮的睡衣。洗完澡，弟弟吃了很多冰淇淋。晚上，他肚子疼，还拉肚子了。妈妈说：“你不应该吃那么多冰淇淋！”(Dìdi zài huāyuán lǐ tī zúqiú, liúle hěn duō hàn. Māma shuō: “Nǐ yīnggāi xǐzǎo. Xiǎoxīn! Dì shang yǒu shuǐ!” Tā yòng xiāngzào hé xǐfàshuǐ xǐzǎo, ránhòu chuān shang yòu ruǎn yòu piàoliang de shuìyī. Xǐ wán zǎo, dìdi chīle hěn duō bīngqílín. Wǎnshang, tā dùzi téng, hái lā dùzi le. Māma shuō: “Nǐ bù yīnggāi chī nàme duō bīngqílín!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "应该 不应该 儿童中文 健康"

en.flash: Mới: medicine, flu, rest, blood, injure, soap, shampoo, soft, lovely, ready | Ôn: stomach-ache, ice cream, doctor, hospital, healthy, check-up, knee, online, you're welcome, pajamas (UK pyjamas) | Tranh truyện (cùng thẻ tiếng Trung): headache, cough, should, injection, be careful, very hot after football, hurts a lot, run to the toilet
en.slide: [Lời cô] Vào bài: "Good afternoon! How are you feeling today? 你们今天身体好吗？" · Chuyển ý: "Let's be doctors. 我们来当医生。" · Khen: "Excellent! 太好了！" · Nhắc: "Wash your hands, please. 请洗手。" · Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung của buổi (cô quyết định có giải nghĩa không): flu, injection, blood / 打针 1) Nghe và chọn A/B/C (dạng Flyers Listening Part 4, 4 câu): What's the matter with Leo? (A flu ✓ / B a broken arm / C a toothache) / What should he take? (A medicine ✓ / B a bath / C a photo) / What does the boy wash his hair with? (A soap / B shampoo ✓ / C water) / What are soft? (A his shoes / B his pyjamas ✓ / C his books) 2) Ghép vấn đề với lời khuyên should / shouldn't (5 cặp): I've got a headache. – You should have a rest. / I've got flu. – You should see a doctor. / My hands are dirty. – You should wash them with soap. / I've got a stomach-ache. – You shouldn't eat ice cream. / I'm tired. – You should go to bed. 3) Đóng vai bác sĩ – bệnh nhân: What's the matter with you? – I've got a cough and a fever. – You should take some medicine. – Thank you, doctor! – You're welcome. Phương án nhiễu trong tranh: necklace / bracelet / sunglasses.
en.truyen: A Busy Day at the Doctor's — Today the doctor is very busy. Leo has got flu. 'You should take this medicine and have a rest,' says the doctor. Xiaomei's brother has got a stomach-ache. 'You shouldn't eat so much ice cream!' Nhan injured his knee and there is a little blood. The nurse washes it with soap and water. 'Are you ready? This won't hurt.' Then she puts on a soft bandage. 'Thank you!' says Nhan. 'You're welcome!' says the nurse. 'Be careful next time!'
en.baihat: What's the Matter? (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — What's the matter? What's the matter? / I've got flu. I've got flu. / You should take some medicine, you should have a rest now, / Get well soon! Get well soon!

zh.flash: Mới: 头疼 tóuténg, 咳嗽 késou, 应该 yīnggāi, 打针 dǎzhēn, 拉肚子 lā dùzi, 受伤 shòushāng, 小心 xiǎoxīn, 流汗 liú hàn, 受不了 shòu bu liǎo | Ôn: 感冒 gǎnmào, 休息 xiūxi, 肚子疼 dùzi téng, 医生 yīshēng, 药 yào, 健康 jiànkāng, 体检 tǐjiǎn, 冰淇淋 bīngqílín, 不客气 bú kèqi, 网上 wǎng shang | Nghe làm quen: 流血 liú xiě, 膝盖 xīgài, 香皂 xiāngzào, 洗发水 xǐfàshuǐ, 软 ruǎn, 睡衣 shuìyī
zh.slide: 1) Nghe và chọn tranh (dạng YCT4 nghe – chọn tranh, 5 câu): 头疼 / 咳嗽 / 肚子疼 / 受伤 / 打针; nghe – chỉ tranh (không chấm, như bài 1 tiếng Anh): 感冒 / 吃药 / 洗发水 / 睡衣. 2) Ghép vấn đề với lời khuyên 应该 / 不应该 (4 cặp): 我头疼。– 你应该休息。/ 我咳嗽，还发烧。– 你应该去看医生。/ 我肚子疼。– 你不应该吃冰淇淋。/ 我流了很多汗。– 你应该洗澡。 3) Đóng vai bác sĩ – bệnh nhân: 你怎么了？——我头疼，还咳嗽。——你应该吃药，多休息。——谢谢医生！——不客气！ Phương án nhiễu: 围巾 / 牛仔裤 / 衬衫. 4) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng tranh phòng khám: rối Leo nói I've got a headache. You should take some medicine., rối Xiaomei nói 我头疼。你应该吃药。(Wǒ tóuténg. Nǐ yīnggāi chī yào.); con tìm: should ↔ 应该 đứng trước động từ ở cả hai tiếng; take medicine ↔ 吃药 (dùng 吃); ice cream ↔ 冰淇淋 âm gần giống. 5) [Chuyển ngữ] Rối Leo kể truyện tiếng Anh 'A Busy Day at the Doctor's'; con tóm tắt cho rối Xiaomei bằng 2 câu tiếng Trung: Leo感冒了，应该吃药，多休息。弟弟肚子疼，不应该吃那么多冰淇淋。(Leo gǎnmào le, yīnggāi chī yào, duō xiūxi. Dìdi dùzi téng, bù yīnggāi chī nàme duō bīngqílín.) [Bản nâng cao] (cho con trội tiếng Anh, ~3 phút) Leo kể: "Today the doctor's waiting room was full of children. I had flu, so the doctor told me to take some medicine and rest for two days. Xiaomei's little brother had a terrible stomach-ache, because he had eaten three ice creams before lunch. The doctor said he shouldn't eat so much ice cream. Then Nhan came in with a bleeding knee. The nurse washed it with soap and water and put on a soft bandage. Before he left, she told him to be more careful next time." → con nói lại cho rối Xiaomei bằng tiếng Trung (tóm 3 ý chính, rồi giải thích vì sao em trai Xiaomei đau bụng). Mẫu: Leo感冒了，医生说他应该吃药，多休息。Xiaomei的弟弟肚子疼，医生说他不应该吃那么多冰淇淋。Nhan的膝盖受伤了，护士用香皂和水帮他洗干净，然后用绷带包好。弟弟为什么肚子疼？因为他吃饭以前吃了三个冰淇淋。 (Leo gǎnmào le, yīshēng shuō tā yīnggāi chī yào, duō xiūxi. Xiaomei de dìdi dùzi téng, yīshēng shuō tā bù yīnggāi chī nàme duō bīngqílín. Nhan de xīgài shòushāng le, hùshi yòng xiāngzào hé shuǐ bāng tā xǐ gānjìng, ránhòu yòng bēngdài bāo hǎo. Dìdi wèi shénme dùzi téng? Yīnwèi tā chī fàn yǐqián chīle sān gè bīngqílín.)
zh.truyen: 医生很忙 — 今天医生很忙。Leo感冒了，医生说：“你应该吃药，多休息。”Xiaomei的弟弟肚子疼，医生说：“你不应该吃那么多冰淇淋！”Nhan的膝盖受伤了，流了一点儿血。护士用香皂和水帮他洗干净，说：“准备好了吗？不会疼的。”然后，她用软软的绷带包好。Nhan说：“谢谢！”护士说：“不客气！下次要注意安全！”(Jīntiān yīshēng hěn máng. Leo gǎnmào le, yīshēng shuō: “Nǐ yīnggāi chī yào, duō xiūxi.” Xiaomei de dìdi dùzi téng, yīshēng shuō: “Nǐ bù yīnggāi chī nàme duō bīngqílín!” Nhan de xīgài shòushāng le, liúle yìdiǎnr xiě. Hùshi yòng xiāngzào hé shuǐ bāng tā xǐ gānjìng, shuō: “Zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma? Bú huì téng de.” Ránhòu, tā yòng ruǎnruǎn de bēngdài bāo hǎo. Nhan shuō: “Xièxie!” Hùshi shuō: “Bú kèqi! Xià cì yào zhùyì ānquán!”)
zh.baihat: 你怎么了 (giai điệu Two Tigers 两只老虎 – cùng giai điệu Frère Jacques của bài tiếng Anh) — 你怎么了？你怎么了？我感冒，我感冒。你应该去休息，你应该吃点药，早点好！早点好！(Nǐ zěnme le? Nǐ zěnme le? Wǒ gǎnmào, wǒ gǎnmào. Nǐ yīnggāi qù xiūxi, nǐ yīnggāi chī diǎn yào, zǎo diǎn hǎo! Zǎo diǎn hǎo!)

en.tu: Mới: kind, pleased, lazy, popular | Ôn (từ nối Unit 7): interested, score, race, coach, gymnastics, x-ray, tent
en.cum: Mới: a kind doctor / be pleased with / a popular sport / Don't be lazy! | Ôn: be interested in / have an x-ray / do gymnastics
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: should / shouldn't; quá khứ trong câu mẫu got hurt] He got hurt when he was playing football. / You should brush your teeth every morning. Don't be lazy! / I'm interested in gymnastics. / Football is a very popular sport. / The coach is pleased with our team. / It's easy to get hurt when you run too fast.
en.truyen: Lazy Nhan — One morning, Nhan is lazy and not careful. He doesn't wash his face or brush his teeth. He goes to the sports hall for a football match. He runs too fast and gets hurt. A kind doctor gives him an x-ray. 'It's easy to get hurt when you run so fast. It isn't broken, but you shouldn't play football this week,' she says. Nhan is interested in the x-ray picture. 'I'm not lazy any more!' he says. His coach is pleased.
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "good habits for kids brush your teeth don't be lazy"

zh.tu: Mới: 脸 liǎn (= face), 刷牙 shuāyá (= brush your teeth), 容易 róngyì (= easy), 马虎 mǎhu (= not careful) | Nghe làm quen: 懒 lǎn (= lazy) | Ôn (từ nối Unit 7): 感兴趣 gǎn xìngqù, 比赛 bǐsài, 体育馆 tǐyùguǎn, X光片 X guāngpiàn, 教练 jiàoliàn, 体操 tǐcāo
zh.cum: Mới: 洗脸 xǐ liǎn / 刷牙 shuāyá / 很容易受伤 hěn róngyì shòushāng / 别马虎 bié mǎhu | Nghe làm quen: 别懒 bié lǎn | Ôn: 对X光片感兴趣 duì X guāngpiàn gǎn xìngqù
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] You should brush your teeth every morning. ↔ 你应该每天早上刷牙。(Nǐ yīnggāi měi tiān zǎoshang shuāyá.) · giống: should ↔ 应该 · khác: every morning cuối câu ↔ 每天早上 trước 刷牙; brush your teeth ↔ 刷牙 (không cần your) / [Ngữ pháp: 应该 / 不应该] 你应该每天早上刷牙、洗脸。(Nǐ yīnggāi měi tiān zǎoshang shuāyá, xǐ liǎn.) / 早上不应该懒，也不应该马虎。(Zǎoshang bù yīnggāi lǎn, yě bù yīnggāi mǎhu.) / 跑得太快很容易受伤。(Pǎo de tài kuài hěn róngyì shòushāng.) / 我对体操很感兴趣。(Wǒ duì tǐcāo hěn gǎn xìngqù.) / 很多人喜欢踢足球。(Hěn duō rén xǐhuan tī zúqiú.) / 他比赛的时候受伤了。(Tā bǐsài de shíhou shòushāng le.)
zh.truyen: 马虎的Nhan — 一天早上，Nhan很懒，也很马虎。他不洗脸，也不刷牙，就去体育馆比赛。比赛的时候，他跑得太快，受伤了。一个很和蔼的医生给他拍了X光片，说：“跑得太快很容易受伤。没有断，可是你这个星期不应该踢足球。”Nhan对X光片很感兴趣。他说：“我以后不懒了！”教练很高兴。(Yì tiān zǎoshang, Nhan hěn lǎn, yě hěn mǎhu. Tā bù xǐ liǎn, yě bù shuāyá, jiù qù tǐyùguǎn bǐsài. Bǐsài de shíhou, tā pǎo de tài kuài, shòushāng le. Yí gè hěn hé'ǎi de yīshēng gěi tā pāile X guāngpiàn, shuō: “Pǎo de tài kuài hěn róngyì shòushāng. Méiyǒu duàn, kěshì nǐ zhège xīngqī bù yīnggāi tī zúqiú.” Nhan duì X guāngpiàn hěn gǎn xìngqù. Tā shuō: “Wǒ yǐhòu bù lǎn le!” Jiàoliàn hěn gāoxìng.)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "刷牙 洗脸 儿童中文 好习惯"

en.tu: Mới: large, low, missing, same, secret | Ôn (từ nối Unit 7): chess, puzzle, collect, golf | Ôn nhanh: you're welcome
en.cum: Mới: a large bag / in a low voice / My glasses are missing. / in the same place / It's a secret! | Ôn: do a puzzle / play chess
en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: should / shouldn't] You shouldn't speak loudly in hospital. You should speak in a low voice. / Grandma's glasses are missing! / We've got the same medicine. / Can you keep a secret?
en.truyen: Grandma's Secret — Grandma is in hospital. Anna and Leo visit her. 'You should speak in a low voice here,' says the nurse. 'How strange! My glasses are missing,' says Grandma. Leo finds them under the bed. They're in the same place as yesterday! Then they hear a voice they know well. It's Grandpa! He comes in with a large bag. 'I have a secret,' he says. 'The doctor says Grandma's blood pressure is better. She can come home tomorrow!'
en.video: Tìm YouTube: "hospital visit kids English story"

zh.tu: Mới: 奇怪 qíguài (= strange), 熟悉 shúxī (= know well) | Nghe làm quen: 秘密 mìmì (= secret) | Ôn (từ nối Unit 7): 下棋 xiàqí, 拼图 pīntú, 眼镜 yǎnjìng, 提 tí | Ôn nhanh: 不客气 bú kèqi
zh.cum: Mới: 很奇怪 hěn qíguài / 很熟悉 hěn shúxī / 熟悉的声音 shúxī de shēngyīn | Nghe làm quen: 这是秘密 zhè shì mìmì | Ôn: 小声说话 xiǎoshēng shuōhuà / 一个大包 yí gè dà bāo / 一样的地方 yíyàng de dìfang
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] You should speak in a low voice in hospital. ↔ 在医院里应该小声说话。(Zài yīyuàn lǐ yīnggāi xiǎoshēng shuōhuà.) · giống: should ↔ 应该 đứng trước động từ; in a low voice ↔ 小声 · khác: in hospital cuối câu ↔ 在医院里 đầu câu; in a low voice sau động từ ↔ 小声 trước 说话; How strange! ↔ 真奇怪！ / [Ngữ pháp: 应该 / 不应该] 在医院里不应该大声说话。(Zài yīyuàn lǐ bù yīnggāi dàshēng shuōhuà.) / 在医院里应该小声说话。(Zài yīyuàn lǐ yīnggāi xiǎoshēng shuōhuà.) / 这个声音很熟悉。(Zhège shēngyīn hěn shúxī.) / 真奇怪，我的眼镜在哪儿？(Zhēn qíguài, wǒ de yǎnjìng zài nǎr?) / 我们吃一样的药。(Wǒmen chī yíyàng de yào.) / 这是一个秘密！(Zhè shì yí gè mìmì!) / [Chuyển ngữ] Con nghe truyện tiếng Anh 'Grandma's Secret', nói lại ý chính cho Xiaomei bằng 2 câu tiếng Trung (ghi âm): 奶奶的眼镜不见了，Leo在床下面找到了。医生说奶奶明天可以回家。(Nǎinai de yǎnjìng bú jiàn le, Leo zài chuáng xiàmiàn zhǎodào le. Yīshēng shuō nǎinai míngtiān kěyǐ huí jiā.)
zh.truyen: 奶奶的秘密 — 奶奶在医院里。Anna和Leo去看她。护士说：“在这里应该小声说话。”奶奶说：“真奇怪，我的眼镜不见了！”Leo在床下面找到了眼镜，和昨天在一样的地方！这时候，他们听到一个很熟悉的声音，是爷爷！爷爷提着一个大包，说：“我有一个秘密：医生说奶奶的高血压好多了，明天可以回家了！”(Nǎinai zài yīyuàn lǐ. Anna hé Leo qù kàn tā. Hùshi shuō: “Zài zhèlǐ yīnggāi xiǎoshēng shuōhuà.” Nǎinai shuō: “Zhēn qíguài, wǒ de yǎnjìng bú jiàn le!” Leo zài chuáng xiàmiàn zhǎodàole yǎnjìng, hé zuótiān zài yíyàng de dìfang! Zhè shíhou, tāmen tīngdào yí gè hěn shúxī de shēngyīn, shì yéye! Yéye tízhe yí gè dà bāo, shuō: “Wǒ yǒu yí gè mìmì: yīshēng shuō nǎinai de gāoxuèyā hǎo duō le, míngtiān kěyǐ huí jiā le!”)
zh.video: Tìm YouTube: "去医院看奶奶 儿童中文 故事"

en.flash: Mới: kind, pleased, lazy, popular, large, low, missing, same, secret | Ôn: interested, score, race, coach, gymnastics, x-ray, tent, chess, puzzle, collect, golf, you're welcome, strange, sports hall, glasses | Tranh truyện (cùng thẻ tiếng Trung): face, brush your teeth, easy, not careful, know well
en.slide: [Lời cô] Vào bài: "Good afternoon! Did you brush your teeth this morning? 今天早上你刷牙了吗？" · Chuyển ý: "Now, read with me. 现在跟我读。" · Khen: "You're so kind! 你真好！" · Nhắc: "Speak in a low voice, please. 请小声说。" · Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung của buổi (cô quyết định có giải nghĩa không): lazy, secret / 马虎, 熟悉 1) Đọc và chọn từ (dạng Flyers Reading Part 3, 5 câu): The doctor is very ___. She helps everyone. (kind / lazy) / Football is a ___ sport. Lots of people play it. (popular / missing) / Grandma's glasses are ___. (missing / pleased) / Please speak in a ___ voice in hospital. (low / large) / Don't tell anyone. It's a ___! (secret / same) Phương án nhiễu: spotted / striped / pocket. 2) Chọn should hoặc shouldn't (4 câu): You ___ brush your teeth every day. / You ___ be lazy in the morning. / You ___ play football with a broken foot. / You ___ speak in a low voice in hospital. 3) Kể lại truyện 'Lazy Nhan' theo 4 tranh, mỗi tranh 1 câu có should / shouldn't. 4) [Chuyển ngữ] (NL5) Rối Xiaomei kể truyện tiếng Trung '马虎的Nhan'; con tóm tắt cho rối Leo bằng 2–3 câu tiếng Anh: Nhan doesn't brush his teeth and he gets hurt at the football match. In the hospital, Grandma's glasses are missing and Nhan finds them. [Bản nâng cao] (cho con trội tiếng Anh, ~3 phút) Leo kể: "One morning Nhan got up late and was very lazy. He didn't wash his face or brush his teeth, and he hurried to the sports hall for a football match. He ran much too fast, and soon he got hurt. A kind doctor took an x-ray and explained that it's easy to get hurt when you run so fast. It wasn't broken, but he shouldn't play football this week. In the same hospital, Nhan visited Grandma, and the nurse asked him to speak in a low voice. Grandma's glasses were missing, but Nhan found them under her bed. Then Grandma told him a secret: she could go home the next day." → con nói lại cho rối Xiaomei bằng tiếng Trung (tóm 3 ý chính, rồi giải thích vì sao Nhan bị thương). Mẫu: Nhan早上很懒，不洗脸，也不刷牙。他受伤了，医生说这个星期他不应该踢足球。在医院里，Nhan找到了奶奶的眼镜，奶奶的秘密是：明天她可以回家了。Nhan为什么受伤了？因为他跑得太快，跑得太快很容易受伤。 (Nhan zǎoshang hěn lǎn, bù xǐ liǎn, yě bù shuāyá. Tā shòushāng le, yīshēng shuō zhège xīngqī tā bù yīnggāi tī zúqiú. Zài yīyuàn lǐ, Nhan zhǎodào le nǎinai de yǎnjìng, nǎinai de mìmì shì: míngtiān tā kěyǐ huí jiā le. Nhan wèi shénme shòushāng le? Yīnwèi tā pǎo de tài kuài, pǎo de tài kuài hěn róngyì shòushāng.)
en.truyen: Lazy Nhan and Grandma's Secret — One morning, Nhan is lazy and not careful. He doesn't wash his face or brush his teeth. He goes to the sports hall for a football match. He runs too fast and gets hurt. A kind doctor gives him an x-ray. 'It's easy to get hurt when you run so fast. It isn't broken, but you shouldn't play football this week.' Nhan is interested in the x-ray picture. In the same hospital, Grandma is in bed. 'You should speak in a low voice here,' says the nurse. Grandma's glasses are missing! Nhan finds them under her bed. 'I've got a secret,' says Grandma. 'I'm going home tomorrow!' Nhan is very pleased.
en.baihat: Should and Shouldn't (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb) — You should brush your teeth each day, teeth each day, teeth each day. / You should brush your teeth each day, don't be lazy, no! / You shouldn't shout in hospital, hospital, hospital. / Speak in a low voice in hospital, shh, shh, shh!

zh.slide: 1) Đọc và chọn từ (như bài 1 tiếng Anh, dạng YCT4 đọc – chọn từ, 5 câu): 医生很___，她帮助每一个人。(和蔼) / 很___人喜欢踢足球。(多) / 奶奶的眼镜___了。(不见) / 在医院里要___声说话。(小) / 别告诉别人，这是___！(秘密) Phương án nhiễu: 懒 / 一样 / 大. 2) Chọn 应该 hoặc 不应该 (4 câu, như bài 2 tiếng Anh): 你___每天刷牙。(应该) / 早上你___懒。(不应该) / 脚受伤了，你___踢足球。(不应该) / 在医院里你___小声说话。(应该) 3) Kể lại truyện '马虎的Nhan' theo 4 tranh (như bài 3 tiếng Anh), mỗi tranh 1 câu có 应该 / 不应该: 早上应该刷牙、洗脸。/ 跑得太快很容易受伤。/ 你这个星期不应该踢足球。/ 在医院里应该小声说话。 4) YCT口试（中级）第三部分 回答问题 (mẫu; cô là giám khảo, từng em; 2 câu hỏi in kèm pinyin, mỗi câu trả lời 3–4 câu): 问题1：生病的时候，你应该做什么？(Shēngbìng de shíhou, nǐ yīnggāi zuò shénme?) — câu mẫu: 生病的时候，我应该去看医生，好好吃药。我应该多喝水，多休息。我不应该吃冰淇淋。(Shēngbìng de shíhou, wǒ yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng, hǎohāo chī yào. Wǒ yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxi. Wǒ bù yīnggāi chī bīngqílín.) / 问题2：你每天早上做什么？(Nǐ měi tiān zǎoshang zuò shénme?) — câu mẫu: 我每天早上刷牙、洗脸。我不懒，也不马虎。踢足球的时候，我不应该跑得太快，因为很容易受伤。(Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang shuāyá, xǐ liǎn. Wǒ bù lǎn, yě bù mǎhu. Tī zúqiú de shíhou, wǒ bù yīnggāi pǎo de tài kuài, yīnwèi hěn róngyì shòushāng.) 5) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng tranh 'Lazy Nhan': He doesn't wash his face or brush his teeth. ↔ 他不刷牙，也不洗脸。(Tā bù shuāyá, yě bù xǐ liǎn.); con tìm: doesn't ↔ 不, or ↔ 也不, brush his teeth ↔ 刷牙 (không cần his); How strange! ↔ 真奇怪！
zh.truyen: 马虎的Nhan — 一天早上，Nhan很懒，也很马虎。他不洗脸，也不刷牙，就去体育馆比赛。他跑得太快，受伤了。一个很和蔼的医生给他拍了X光片，说：“跑得太快很容易受伤。没有断，可是你这个星期不应该踢足球。”Nhan对X光片很感兴趣。在同一个医院里，奶奶在床上休息。护士说：“在这里应该小声说话。”奶奶的眼镜不见了！Nhan在床下面找到了。奶奶说：“我有一个秘密：我明天回家！”Nhan很高兴。(Yì tiān zǎoshang, Nhan hěn lǎn, yě hěn mǎhu. Tā bù xǐ liǎn, yě bù shuāyá, jiù qù tǐyùguǎn bǐsài. Tā pǎo de tài kuài, shòushāng le. Yí gè hěn hé'ǎi de yīshēng gěi tā pāile X guāngpiàn, shuō: “Pǎo de tài kuài hěn róngyì shòushāng. Méiyǒu duàn, kěshì nǐ zhège xīngqī bù yīnggāi tī zúqiú.” Nhan duì X guāngpiàn hěn gǎn xìngqù. Zài tóng yí gè yīyuàn lǐ, nǎinai zài chuáng shang xiūxi. Hùshi shuō: “Zài zhèlǐ yīnggāi xiǎoshēng shuōhuà.” Nǎinai de yǎnjìng bú jiàn le! Nhan zài chuáng xiàmiàn zhǎodào le. Nǎinai shuō: “Wǒ yǒu yí gè mìmì: wǒ míngtiān huí jiā!” Nhan hěn gāoxìng.)
zh.baihat: 应该和不应该 (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb, như bài tiếng Anh) — 每天应该刷刷牙，刷刷牙，刷刷牙。每天应该刷刷牙，不要懒哦！医院里面别大声，别大声，别大声。医院里面小声说，嘘，嘘，嘘！(Měi tiān yīnggāi shuā shua yá, shuā shua yá, shuā shua yá. Měi tiān yīnggāi shuā shua yá, bú yào lǎn o! Yīyuàn lǐmiàn bié dàshēng, bié dàshēng, bié dàshēng. Yīyuàn lǐmiàn xiǎoshēng shuō, xū, xū, xū!)

zh.cau: [Cầu nối] Today is a special day. ↔ 今天是特别的一天。(Jīntiān shì tèbié de yì tiān.) · giống: Today is ↔ 今天是 · khác: a special day ↔ 特别的一天 (a ↔ 一, tính từ + 的 đứng trước) / [Ngữ pháp: 应该 / 不应该] 今天是特别的一天，奶奶回家了！(Jīntiān shì tèbié de yì tiān, nǎinai huí jiā le!) / 可怜的Leo！他又咳嗽了。(Kělián de Leo! Tā yòu késou le.) / 生病的时候，不应该吃太油的菜。(Shēngbìng de shíhou, bù yīnggāi chī tài yóu de cài.) / 你应该吃健康的东西。(Nǐ yīnggāi chī jiànkāng de dōngxi.) / 奶奶应该吃健康的菜。(Nǎinai yīnggāi chī jiànkāng de cài.) / 一家人在一起，很幸福。(Yì jiā rén zài yìqǐ, hěn xìngfú.)
zh.truyen: 特别的一天 — 今天是特别的一天，奶奶从医院回家了！妈妈做了一顿特别的晚饭，可是菜不油。妈妈说：“奶奶应该吃健康的菜。”Leo又咳嗽了。奶奶说：“可怜的Leo！你应该多喝热水，多休息。”一家人在一起，大家都觉得很幸福。(Jīntiān shì tèbié de yì tiān, nǎinai cóng yīyuàn huí jiā le! Māma zuòle yí dùn tèbié de wǎnfàn, kěshì cài bù yóu. Māma shuō: “Nǎinai yīnggāi chī jiànkāng de cài.” Leo yòu késou le. Nǎinai shuō: “Kělián de Leo! Nǐ yīnggāi duō hē rè shuǐ, duō xiūxi.” Yì jiā rén zài yìqǐ, dàjiā dōu juéde hěn xìngfú.)

en.cau: [Ngữ pháp: What's the matter? và should / shouldn't – ôn] What's the matter? – I've got a headache. / You should turn off the TV and go to bed. / You shouldn't watch TV all day when you're ill. / The news says lots of children have got flu. / I'm very hot after football. – You should have a bath. / [Chuyển ngữ] (NL5) Con nghe bản tin tiếng Trung '新闻里的感冒', nói lại ý chính cho Leo bằng 2 câu tiếng Anh (ghi âm): The news says lots of children have got flu. We should wash our hands and rest.
en.truyen: Flu on the News — Dad is watching the news on channel 1. 'Lots of children have got flu this month,' says the news programme. 'You should wash your hands with soap and get lots of rest.' Leo is watching too. 'What's the matter, Leo?' asks Dad. 'I've got a headache.' 'Then you should turn off the TV and go to bed!'

zh.cum: Ôn: 应该吃药 yīnggāi chī yào / 关掉电视 guāndiào diànshì / 用香皂洗手 yòng xiāngzào xǐ shǒu / 多休息 duō xiūxi
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] What's the matter? – I've got a headache. ↔ 你怎么了？——我头疼。(Nǐ zěnme le? — Wǒ tóuténg.) · giống: hỏi thăm – trả lời ngắn · khác: I've got a headache ↔ 我头疼 (không có got / a); The news says … ↔ 新闻说…… / [Ngữ pháp: 你怎么了？và 应该 / 不应该 – ôn] 你怎么了？——我头疼。(Nǐ zěnme le? — Wǒ tóuténg.) / 你应该关掉电视，去睡觉。(Nǐ yīnggāi guāndiào diànshì, qù shuìjiào.) / 生病的时候不应该一直看电视。(Shēngbìng de shíhou bù yīnggāi yìzhí kàn diànshì.) / 新闻说最近很多孩子感冒了。(Xīnwén shuō zuìjìn hěn duō háizi gǎnmào le.) / 踢完足球，我流了很多汗。——你应该洗澡。(Tī wán zúqiú, wǒ liúle hěn duō hàn. — Nǐ yīnggāi xǐzǎo.)
zh.truyen: 新闻里的感冒 — 爸爸正在看一频道的新闻。新闻说：“这个月很多孩子感冒了，大家应该用香皂洗手，多休息。”Leo也在看。爸爸问：“Leo，你怎么了？”Leo说：“我头疼。”爸爸说：“那你应该关掉电视，去睡觉！”(Bàba zhèngzài kàn yī píndào de xīnwén. Xīnwén shuō: “Zhège yuè hěn duō háizi gǎnmào le, dàjiā yīnggāi yòng xiāngzào xǐ shǒu, duō xiūxi.” Leo yě zài kàn. Bàba wèn: “Leo, nǐ zěnme le?” Leo shuō: “Wǒ tóuténg.” Bàba shuō: “Nà nǐ yīnggāi guāndiào diànshì, qù shuìjiào!”)

(soap) / What should they get lots of? (rest) / What should Leo turn off? (the TV) 3) Làm việc nhóm – thực đơn 'A Special Day' cho bà: Grandma should eat ___. / She shouldn't eat rich food.
en.truyen: A Special Day — Today is a special day. Grandma is coming home from hospital! Mum is cooking a special dinner, but it isn't rich food. 'Grandma should eat healthy food,' says Mum. Leo has got a cough again. 'Poor Leo!' says Grandma. 'You should drink warm water and rest.' After dinner, Dad turns on the news. 'Lots of children have got flu this month. You should wash your hands with soap.' 'Leo, did you hear that?' says Grandma. Everyone laughs. They're very happy to be together.
en.baihat: Wash Your Hands (giai điệu Row Row Row Your Boat) — Wash, wash, wash your hands, wash them with some soap! / Rest and sleep and eat good food, don't get flu, I hope! / Wash, wash, wash your hair, shampoo makes it soft! / Healthy, happy, every day, a special day for us!

zh.flash: Mới: 特别 tèbié, 幸福 xìngfú | Ôn: 流汗 liú hàn, 药 yào, 感冒 gǎnmào, 休息 xiūxi, 受伤 shòushāng, 头疼 tóuténg, 咳嗽 késou, 感兴趣 gǎn xìngqù, 高兴 gāoxìng, 大 dà, 一样 yíyàng, 新闻 xīnwén, 关掉 guāndiào, 节目 jiémù | Nghe làm quen: 可怜 kělián, 油 yóu, 香皂 xiāngzào, 洗发水 xǐfàshuǐ, 软 ruǎn, 准备好 zhǔnbèi hǎo, 和蔼 hé'ǎi, 懒 lǎn, 小声 xiǎoshēng, 不见了 bú jiàn le, 秘密 mìmì, 频道 píndào, 流血 liú xiě
zh.slide: 1) Ôn không tranh – cô đọc câu, con nói từ (6 câu, như bài 1 tiếng Anh): 生病的时候要吃它。(药) / 用它洗头发。(洗发水) / 用它洗手。(香皂) / 红色的，在身体里。(血) / 不要告诉别人！(秘密 – con chỉ tranh) / Leo又咳嗽了，真___！(可怜). 2) Đọc bản tin và phán đoán đúng/sai (dạng YCT4 đọc – phán đoán, 4 câu): 最近很多孩子感冒了。(✓) / 大家应该少洗手。(✗) / Leo头疼。(✓) / 爸爸让Leo一直看电视。(✗) 3) Làm việc nhóm – thực đơn '特别的一天' cho bà: 奶奶应该吃___。/ 奶奶不应该吃___。 4) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng bản tin 'Flu on the News' (bảng tiếng Anh và bảng tiếng Trung đặt cạnh nhau): Lots of children have got flu. ↔ 很多孩子感冒了。/ You should wash your hands with soap. ↔ 你们应该用香皂洗手。(Hěn duō háizi gǎnmào le. / Nǐmen yīnggāi yòng xiāngzào xǐ shǒu.); con nối từng dòng hai bảng, nhận xét: have got ↔ 了 (đã xảy ra), children (số nhiều) ↔ 孩子 không đổi; you (cả lớp) ↔ 你们; wash … with soap ↔ 用香皂洗 (用 + đồ vật đứng trước động từ). 5) [Chuyển ngữ] Con đọc bảng tin sức khỏe tiếng Anh (Lots of children have got flu. / Wash your hands with soap. / Get lots of rest. / Don't watch TV all day.), nói lại 2–3 ý chính cho bạn chỉ hiểu tiếng Trung: 最近很多孩子感冒了。大家应该多洗手，多休息，不应该一直看电视。(Zuìjìn hěn duō háizi gǎnmào le. Dàjiā yīnggāi duō xǐ shǒu, duō xiūxi, bù yīnggāi yìzhí kàn diànshì.) [Bản nâng cao] (cho con trội tiếng Anh, ~3 phút) Leo đọc bản tin: "Good evening. This month, lots of children in our city have got flu. Flu spreads easily at school, because children often touch the same things. Doctors say you should wash your hands with soap before you eat and after you play. If you have a cough or a headache, you should stay at home and get lots of rest. You should also drink warm water and eat healthy food, not rich food. And please don't watch TV all day – go to bed early!" → con nói lại cho rối Xiaomei bằng tiếng Trung (tóm 3 ý chính, rồi giải thích vì sao ở trường dễ bị cảm). Mẫu: 最近很多孩子感冒了。大家应该用香皂洗手；咳嗽、头疼的时候，应该多休息，多喝热水。不应该一直看电视。为什么在学校很容易感冒？因为孩子们都用一样的东西。 (Zuìjìn hěn duō háizi gǎnmào le. Dàjiā yīnggāi yòng xiāngzào xǐ shǒu; késou, tóuténg de shíhou, yīnggāi duō xiūxi, duō hē rè shuǐ. Bù yīnggāi yìzhí kàn diànshì. Wèi shénme zài xuéxiào hěn róngyì gǎnmào? Yīnwèi háizimen dōu yòng yíyàng de dōngxi.)
zh.truyen: 特别的一天 — 今天是特别的一天，奶奶从医院回家了！妈妈做了一顿特别的晚饭，可是菜不油。妈妈说：“奶奶应该吃健康的菜。”Leo又咳嗽了，奶奶说：“可怜的Leo！你应该多喝热水，多休息。”吃完饭，爸爸打开电视看新闻。新闻说：“这个月很多孩子感冒了，大家应该用香皂洗手。”奶奶说：“Leo，你听到了吗？”大家都笑了。一家人在一起，大家都觉得很幸福。(Jīntiān shì tèbié de yì tiān, nǎinai cóng yīyuàn huí jiā le! Māma zuòle yí dùn tèbié de wǎnfàn, kěshì cài bù yóu. Māma shuō: “Nǎinai yīnggāi chī jiànkāng de cài.” Leo yòu késou le, nǎinai shuō: “Kělián de Leo! Nǐ yīnggāi duō hē rè shuǐ, duō xiūxi.” Chī wán fàn, bàba dǎkāi diànshì kàn xīnwén. Xīnwén shuō: “Zhège yuè hěn duō háizi gǎnmào le, dàjiā yīnggāi yòng xiāngzào xǐ shǒu.” Nǎinai shuō: “Leo, nǐ tīngdào le ma?” Dàjiā dōu xiào le. Yì jiā rén zài yìqǐ, dàjiā dōu juéde hěn xìngfú.)
zh.baihat: 洗洗手 (giai điệu Row Row Row Your Boat, như bài tiếng Anh) — 洗，洗，洗洗手，用香皂洗手！多睡多休息吃好饭，不要感冒哦！洗，洗，洗头发，头发软软的！健康快乐每一天，特别的一天！(Xǐ, xǐ, xǐ xi shǒu, yòng xiāngzào xǐ shǒu! Duō shuì duō xiūxi chī hǎo fàn, bú yào gǎnmào o! Xǐ, xǐ, xǐ tóufa, tóufa ruǎnruǎn de! Jiànkāng kuàilè měi yì tiān, tèbié de yì tiān!)

en.truyen: Nhan at the Hospital — Nhan injured his arm when he was playing football. There is a little blood. At the hospital, a kind nurse looks at it with a torch. 'Are you ready? 'You should rest your arm for a week.'

zh.tu: Ôn: 打针 dǎzhēn, 受伤 shòushāng, 药 yào, 护士 hùshi, 准备好 zhǔnbèi hǎo, 一样 yíyàng, 感兴趣 gǎn xìngqù | Ôn (truyện Unit 5): 惊喜 jīngxǐ, 杂志 zázhì, 手电筒 shǒudiàntǒng, 担心 dānxīn | Ôn (cùng chủ đề): 勇敢 yǒnggǎn
zh.cum: Ôn: 去医院打针 qù yīyuàn dǎzhēn / 流了一点儿血 liúle yìdiǎnr xiě / 很勇敢 hěn yǒnggǎn / 准备好了吗 zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] He got hurt when he was playing football. ↔ 他踢足球的时候受伤了。(Tā tī zúqiú de shíhou shòushāng le.) · giống: chuyện đã xảy ra: got (quá khứ) ↔ 了 · khác: when … đứng sau ↔ ……的时候 đứng trước / [Ngữ pháp: 应该 / 不应该 – chuyển ngữ Anh → Trung] [Chuyển ngữ] What's the matter with you? → 你怎么了？(Nǐ zěnme le?) / Are you ready? You need an injection. → 准备好了吗？你要打针。(Zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma? Nǐ yào dǎzhēn.) / It doesn't hurt! → 不疼！(Bù téng!) / You should rest your arm for a week. → 你的胳膊应该休息一个星期。(Nǐ de gēbo yīnggāi xiūxi yí gè xīngqī.)
zh.truyen: 勇敢的Nhan — Nhan踢足球的时候，胳膊受伤了，流了一点儿血。在医院里，一个很好心的护士用手电筒看了看。她说：“准备好了吗？你要打针。”Nhan有一点儿担心，可是他很勇敢。他看了一本关于医生的杂志。Nhan说：“真没想到！不疼！”医生很高兴，说：“你的胳膊应该休息一个星期。”(Nhan tī zúqiú de shíhou, gēbo shòushāng le, liúle yìdiǎnr xiě. Zài yīyuàn lǐ, yí gè hěn hǎoxīn de hùshi yòng shǒudiàntǒng kànle kàn. Tā shuō: “Zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma? Nǐ yào dǎzhēn.” Nhan yǒu yìdiǎnr dānxīn, kěshì tā hěn yǒnggǎn. Tā kànle yì běn guānyú yīshēng de zázhì. Nhan shuō: “Zhēn méi xiǎngdào! Bù téng!” Yīshēng hěn gāoxìng, shuō: “Nǐ de gēbo yīnggāi xiūxi yí gè xīngqī.”)

Leo sends it by post and Anna sends her a funny cartoon online. Xiaomei is very pleased. 'You're all so kind!'

zh.cum: Ôn: 多休息 duō xiūxi / 好好儿吃药 hǎohāor chī yào / 特别的明信片 tèbié de míngxìnpiàn / 寄明信片 jì míngxìnpiàn / 在网上发卡通片 zài wǎng shang fā kǎtōngpiàn
zh.cau: [Cầu nối] You should rest and take your medicine. ↔ 你应该多休息，好好儿吃药。(Nǐ yīnggāi duō xiūxi, hǎohāor chī yào.) · giống: should ↔ 应该 · khác: take medicine ↔ 吃药 (dùng 吃 như eat); send it by post ↔ 寄 / [Ngữ pháp: 你怎么了？và 应该 / 不应该 – Phiên dịch nhí Trung → Anh] 你怎么了？——我头疼。(Nǐ zěnme le? — Wǒ tóuténg.) / 你应该去看医生。(Nǐ yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.) / 你不应该吃冰淇淋。(Nǐ bù yīnggāi chī bīngqílín.) / 他踢足球的时候受伤了。(Tā tī zúqiú de shíhou shòushāng le.)
zh.truyen: 给Xiaomei的明信片 — Xiaomei感冒了，不能去上学。可怜的Xiaomei！同学们给她做了一张特别的明信片：“早点好！你应该多休息，好好儿吃药！”Leo把明信片寄给她，Anna在网上给她发了一个有趣的卡通片。Xiaomei很高兴：“你们都对我真好！”(Xiaomei gǎnmào le, bù néng qù shàngxué. Kělián de Xiaomei! Tóngxuémen gěi tā zuòle yì zhāng tèbié de míngxìnpiàn: “Zǎo diǎn hǎo! Nǐ yīnggāi duō xiūxi, hǎohāor chī yào!” Leo bǎ míngxìnpiàn jì gěi tā, Anna zài wǎng shang gěi tā fāle yí gè yǒuqù de kǎtōngpiàn. Xiaomei hěn gāoxìng: “Nǐmen dōu duì wǒ zhēn hǎo!”)

en.slide: [Lời cô] Vào bài: "Good afternoon, little doctors! 小医生们好！" · Chuyển ý: "Now, tell Leo in English. 现在用英文告诉Leo。" · Khen: "Perfect! 完全正确！" · Nhắc: "Take turns, please. 请轮流说。" · Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung của buổi (cô quyết định có giải nghĩa không): injure, get well soon / 受不了 1) Đọc truyện 'Nhan at the Hospital' và điền 1–2 từ (dạng Flyers Reading Part 5, 5 chỗ trống): Nhan injured his ___. (arm) / The nurse looks at it with a ___. (torch) / Nhan reads a ___ about doctors. (magazine) / The doctor is ___. (pleased) / He should rest his arm for a ___. (week) 2) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp – Trung → Anh (4 câu): 你怎么了？/ 我咳嗽，还发烧。/ 你应该去看医生。/ 他踢足球的时候受伤了。 3) Dự án 'Thiệp chúc mau khỏe': mỗi nhóm viết 1 bưu thiếp: Dear ___, Get well soon! You should ___. At the hospital, a kind nurse looked at it carefully with a torch. She told him he needed an injection. Nhan was worried at first, but he was brave and read a magazine about doctors while he waited. The injection didn't hurt at all, so he was really surprised. The doctor said he should rest his arm for a week. When he got home, his friends sent him a special postcard: 'Get well soon! You shouldn't play football this week!'" → con nói lại cho rối Xiaomei bằng tiếng Trung (tóm 3 ý chính, rồi giải thích vì sao tuần này Nhan không nên đá bóng). Mẫu: Nhan踢足球的时候胳膊受伤了，在医院里要打针。他有一点儿担心，可是很勇敢，打针一点儿也不疼。朋友们给他寄来一张特别的明信片。为什么这个星期他不应该踢足球？因为他的胳膊受伤了，应该休息一个星期。 (Nhan tī zúqiú de shíhou gēbo shòushāng le, zài yīyuàn lǐ yào dǎzhēn. Yīnwèi tā de gēbo shòushāng le, yīnggāi xiūxi yí gè xīngqī.)
en.truyen: Nhan at the Hospital — Nhan injured his arm when he was playing football. There is a little blood. At the hospital, a kind nurse looks at it with a torch. 'Are you ready? You need an injection,' she says. Nhan is worried, but he is brave. He reads a magazine about doctors. 'What a surprise! It doesn't hurt!' The doctor is pleased. 'You should rest your arm for a week.' At home, his friends send him a special postcard and a funny cartoon online: 'Get well soon, Nhan! You shouldn't play football this week!'
en.baihat: Get Well Soon (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star) — Get well, get well, get well soon, / Take your medicine, rest in your room. / Wash with soap and drink some tea, / Soon you'll play outside with me! / Get well, get well, get well soon, / We all miss you, get well soon!

zh.truyen: 勇敢的Nhan — Nhan踢足球的时候，胳膊受伤了，流了一点儿血。在医院里，一个很好心的护士用手电筒看了看。她说：“准备好了吗？你要打针。”Nhan有一点儿担心，可是他很勇敢。他看了一本关于医生的杂志。Nhan说：“真没想到！不疼！”医生很高兴，说：“你的胳膊应该休息一个星期。”回到家，朋友们给他寄来一张特别的明信片，还在网上发来一个好笑的卡通片：“Nhan，早点好！这个星期你不应该踢足球！”(Nhan tī zúqiú de shíhou, gēbo shòushāng le, liúle yìdiǎnr xiě. Zài yīyuàn lǐ, yí gè hěn hǎoxīn de hùshi yòng shǒudiàntǒng kànle kàn. Tā shuō: “Zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma? Nǐ yào dǎzhēn.” Nhan yǒu yìdiǎnr dānxīn, kěshì tā hěn yǒnggǎn. Tā kànle yì běn guānyú yīshēng de zázhì. Nhan shuō: “Zhēn méi xiǎngdào! Bù téng!” Yīshēng hěn gāoxìng, shuō: “Nǐ de gēbo yīnggāi xiūxi yí gè xīngqī.” Huí dào jiā, péngyoumen gěi tā jì lái yì zhāng tèbié de míngxìnpiàn, hái zài wǎng shang fā lái yí gè hǎoxiào de kǎtōngpiàn: “Nhan, zǎo diǎn hǎo! Zhège xīngqī nǐ bù yīnggāi tī zúqiú!”)
zh.baihat: 早点好 (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, như bài tiếng Anh) — 早点好呀早点好！好好吃药多睡觉。香皂洗手喝杯茶，很快一起出去玩！早点好呀早点好！我们想你，早点好！(Zǎo diǎn hǎo ya zǎo diǎn hǎo! Hǎohāo chī yào duō shuìjiào. Xiāngzào xǐ shǒu hē bēi chá, hěn kuài yìqǐ chūqù wán! Zǎo diǎn hǎo ya zǎo diǎn hǎo! Wǒmen xiǎng nǐ, zǎo diǎn hǎo!)
